9_2929.concept: George 人名标题开头

patterns.name: George 人名/标题

en.concept: Lexical triggers for specific subword fragments
en.description: Strong activations fall on several specific subword fragments: the beginning of the name George, the name fragment Clemens, and expert, tasks, and academic. These words occur respectively in biographical entries, historical names, marketing, patents, and academic medical contexts.

patterns.name: George at the start of a name

patterns.name: Clemens within proper names

patterns.name: expert
patterns.context: Describes a service team in SEO promotional copy; nearby words include company, offers, and SEO service.

patterns.name: tasks
patterns.context: Appears in the phrase perform certain tasks when describing the configuration of computing devices through graphical interface elements.

patterns.name: academic

9_2929.concept: 特定词片段的词汇触发
9_2929.description: 强激活落在若干特定词片段上：George 人名开头、Clemens 姓名片段，以及 expert、tasks、academic；这些词分别出现在人物条目、历史人名、营销、专利和学术医学语境中。

patterns.name: 人名中的 George
patterns.context: George 位于条目或标题开头，通常后接姓氏；也可能接职务说明或换行后的重复条目。

patterns.name: 专名内部的 Clemens
patterns.context: 德语历史人名或地名中，名称被分词片段切分；激活集中在 Clem- 片段。

patterns.name: expert
patterns.context: SEO 服务宣传文案中，形容服务团队；周围有 company、offers、SEO service 等词。

patterns.name: tasks
patterns.context: 描述图形界面元素配置计算设备时，出现在 perform certain tasks 的搭配中。

patterns.name: academic
patterns.context: 出现在 academic institutions 或 academic medical center 中，指学术机构或医疗中心。
patterns.domain: 学术出版伦理说明、医学研究摘要

en.concept: George at the start of a biographical entry
en.description: The strongest pattern is the name George and its name fragments at the beginning of Wikipedia entries; other sporadic activations occur respectively on expert in SEO copy, the historical proper name Ems, resulting in research contexts, and weekend and attend in emails. No shared local trigger form is apparent.

patterns.name: The name George
patterns.context: A personal name beginning with George at the start of an entry or title; some examples are followed by a parenthetical description of the person's role, a line break, or a repeated name.

patterns.name: Adjective expert
patterns.context: Appears in SEO service advertising copy, describing team members.

patterns.name: Proper name Ems
patterns.context: The name of a historical event, followed by a description of the meeting and its participants.

patterns.name: resulting
patterns.context: In a research plan, modifies DNA complexes in a description of experimental subjects to be studied.

patterns.name: weekend
patterns.context: In an email, refers to scheduling when discussing an event being held on another weekend.

patterns.name: attend
patterns.context: In promotional email copy, describes a winner traveling to Florida to attend an event.

9_2929.concept: George 人名条目开头
9_2929.description: 最强模式是维基百科条目开头的 George 人名及姓名片段；其余零散激活分别落在 SEO 文案的 expert、历史专名 Ems、科研语境的 resulting，以及邮件中的 weekend、attend，未见共同局部触发形式。

patterns.name: 人物名 George
patterns.trigger: «George»；其后跟姓名组成部分，如 « Se»ay、« B»«aird»、« H.»« W»inner Jr.、« Oliver»、« Dust»«an»
patterns.context: 条目或标题开头，以 George 开始的人名；部分例子后接人物身份括注、换行或重复姓名。
patterns.domain: 英文维基百科人物条目

patterns.name: 形容词 expert
patterns.context: 出现在介绍 SEO 服务的广告文案中，修饰团队成员。

patterns.name: 专名 Ems
patterns.context: 历史事件名称，后接关于会议及与会者的说明。

patterns.name: resulting
patterns.context: 科研计划说明中，修饰 DNA complexes，处于将被研究的实验对象描述里。

patterns.name: weekend
patterns.context: 邮件中讨论活动若安排在另一个周末时，表示时间安排。

patterns.name: attend
patterns.context: 邮件广告中描述中奖者前往佛罗里达参加活动。

en.concept: George at the beginning of a person’s name
en.description: The strongest activation is concentrated on the English name “George” at the start of entries; weaker activations are scattered across patent quantity phrases, mathematical multiplication signs, medical comparisons, auditory encoding, and date formats, with no shared local trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Person names beginning with George
patterns.context: The first word of an English Wikipedia entry or section; followed by a surname, middle name, and occasionally a title or occupation.

patterns.name: Quantity expressions in technical phrases
patterns.context: In patent background text, describes the minimum amount of information required by a device; nearby qualifiers include “minimum” and “required”.

patterns.name: Multiplication sign in a mathematical formula
patterns.context: Numbers multiplied by variables in an algebraic expression, within a formula or mathematical expression after a line break.

patterns.name: “direct” in a comparison structure
patterns.context: Contrasts parent training with direct clinic treatment in a sentence comparing two interventions.
patterns.domain: Medical research abstract or grant text

patterns.name: “encoded” in descriptions of sound encoding
patterns.context: Describes how the cochlea encodes sound, followed by an agent or mechanism.

patterns.name: Month names in dates
patterns.context: In a date heading format, a month, day, and year follow the weekday.

9_2929.concept: George 人名开头
9_2929.description: 最强激活集中于条目开头的英文人名“George”；其余较弱激活分散在专利数量短语、数学乘号、医学比较、听觉编码和日期格式中，未见共同局部触发模式。

patterns.name: George 开头的人名
patterns.context: 作为英文维基百科条目或小节开头的人名首词；其后接姓氏、姓名中间部分，偶尔接头衔或职业说明。

patterns.name: 技术短语中的数量表达
patterns.context: 专利背景文本中，描述设备需要的最少信息量；附近有“minimum”“required”等限定词。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的乘号
patterns.context: 代数式中数字与变量相乘，处于公式及换行后的数学表达中。

patterns.name: 比较结构中的 direct
patterns.context: 与 parent training 对照 direct clinic treatment，出现在比较两种干预方式的句子中。
patterns.domain: 医学研究摘要或资助文本

patterns.name: 声音编码表述中的 encoded
patterns.context: 描述耳蜗如何编码声音，后接施事或机制说明。

patterns.name: 日期中的月份名
patterns.context: 日期标题格式中，星期后接月份、日期和年份。

en.concept: Specific word-form fragments
en.description: Primarily responds to the name George at the beginning of entries; it also responds to the suffix -ased within Released and Increased, the latter occurring in a biomedical research results description.

patterns.name: Name George
patterns.context: George appears at the beginning of an entry or passage, often as the title of a biographical entry; activation also appears again on George within the same passage.

patterns.name: Word ending -ased
patterns.context: The word-internal suffix -ased is marked separately, forming Released.

patterns.name: Word ending -ased
patterns.context: The word-internal suffix -ased is marked separately, forming Increased; it is followed by research results or biomedical subjects.

9_2929.concept: 特定词形片段
9_2929.description: 主要响应条目开头的人名 George；另响应词内后缀 -ased，出现在 Released 和 Increased 中，后者见于生物医学研究结果描述。

patterns.name: 名字 George
patterns.trigger: «George»；有时后接 « B»«aird»、« H»、« Oliver»，或未标记姓氏
patterns.context: George 位于条目或片段开头，常为人物条目标题；激活也会在同一片段再次出现在 George

patterns.name: 词尾 -ased
patterns.context: 词内后缀 -ased 被单独标记，构成 Released

patterns.name: 词尾 -ased
patterns.context: 词内后缀 -ased 被单独标记，构成 Increased；后接研究结果或生物医学对象

en.concept: Local word-form and marker patterns
en.description: Strong activation primarily occurs on the name fragment George at the beginning of entries; Category in code or encyclopedia categories, French place-name entry formatting, and a mathematical expression also appear, showing several distinct local patterns.

patterns.name: George at the beginning of a person’s name
patterns.context: Entry fragments begin with George, followed by a surname or middle-name initial; sometimes the name is repeated or an occupation is added parenthetically.

patterns.name: Category XML marker
patterns.context: A category name used as tag content or a processing target in XML/template code.

patterns.name: Wikipedia category term
patterns.context: A category marker at the end of an encyclopedia entry, followed by the category name.

patterns.name: French place names and entry formatting
patterns.context: A French place-name entry begins with the name, followed by administrative details and fields such as population.

patterns.name: Mathematical formula operator
patterns.context: An equation or function expression followed by an instruction to solve.

9_2929.concept: 局部词形与标记模式
9_2929.description: 主要对条目开头的 George 人名片段强烈激活；另见代码或百科分类中的 Category、法语地名条目格式，以及一段数学表达式，呈现数种彼此差异的局部模式。

patterns.name: George 人名开头
patterns.context: 条目片段以 George 开头，后接姓氏或中间名缩写；有时重复一次，或附职业括注

patterns.name: Category XML 标记
patterns.context: XML/模板代码中作为标签内容或处理对象的类别名称

patterns.name: Wikipedia 分类词
patterns.context: 百科条目末尾的分类标记，后接分类名称

patterns.name: 法语地名及条目格式
patterns.context: 法语地名条目开头，后接行政区说明和人口等栏目

patterns.name: 数学公式运算符
patterns.context: 方程/函数表达式后接求解指令

en.concept: none
en.description: Activation occurs in NIH aims sections, neuropharmacological terminology, paper table markers, and various proper names in papers and encyclopedias; no stable semantic or word-form pattern spans all the passages.

patterns.name: Grant-project aims section marker
patterns.context: In NIH project abstracts or research aims text, OBJECTIVE: is followed by a sentence stating the research objective.

patterns.name: “neuromodulators” in neuropharmacology terminology
patterns.context: When listing noradrenergic or serotonergic modulators, the word neuromodulators is marked across subword fragments.

patterns.name: Table references and captions
patterns.context: Near text correcting or citing a table in the paper, or near table markers.

patterns.name: Nelson Stepanyan in a person’s name
patterns.context: A person’s name appears in heading- or entry-like form, with the name marked across subword fragments.

patterns.name: Song-title phrase
patterns.context: A song title appears in a heading and body text; “Me” in the title phrase is marked.

patterns.name: Fracture-risk heading terminology
patterns.context: Terms for non-ossifying fibroma and fracture risk are marked in a medical paper title.

patterns.name: Chemical names of silicon hydrides
patterns.context: A chemical substance name or category entry, with several names containing silicon/sil- roots listed consecutively.

patterns.name: Crystallographic captions and data labels
patterns.context: A crystal-structure caption describes ellipsoid probability levels and omitted hydrogen atoms, adjacent to a crystal data table label.

9_2929.concept: none
9_2929.description: 激活分布于 NIH 目标段、神经药理术语、论文表格标记及多种论文/百科专名中；未见贯穿所有片段的稳定语义或词形模式。

patterns.name: 基金项目目标段落标记
patterns.context: NIH 项目摘要或研究目标文本中，OBJECTIVE: 后接研究目的句

patterns.name: 神经药理学术语中的 neuromodulators

patterns.name: 人名中的 Nelson Stepanyan
patterns.context: 人名以标题式或词条式形式出现，名字被分词片段标记

patterns.name: 歌曲标题短语
patterns.context: 歌曲名在标题和正文中出现；标题词组中的“Me”被标记

patterns.name: 骨折风险标题术语

patterns.name: 硅氢化物化学名称
patterns.context: 化学物质名称或类别条目，多个含 silicon/sil- 词根的名称连续列举

patterns.name: 晶体学图注与数据标签

en.concept: Richard string and local fragments
en.description: The most prominent recurring cue is the English proper name Richard, found across several text types; some numbers, dates, abbreviations, and technical word fragments also activate, but their trigger positions and contexts are inconsistent.

patterns.name: Fragments related to the name Richard
patterns.context: The proper name Richard appears in English text; activation falls on the name, while the surname or remaining parts of the full name are usually not equally activated.
patterns.domain: Various English texts, including papers, encyclopedias, legal documents, and forums

patterns.name: Numeric or date expressions
patterns.context: Strong activation occurs in local expressions of numbers, years, dates, measurements, or quantities, but trigger positions vary.

patterns.name: Other proper names and terminology fragments
patterns.context: A few passages activate on local subwords within names, abbreviations, or technical terms; no consistent contextual condition is apparent.

9_2929.concept: Richard 字符串及局部片段
9_2929.description: 最显著的重复线索是英文专名 Richard，分布于多类文本；此外，若干数字、日期、缩写及专业词片段也激活，触发位置和语境不一致。

patterns.name: Richard 名字相关片段
patterns.context: 英文文本中出现专名 Richard；激活落在该名字上，名字后的姓氏或姓名其余部分通常未同等激活。
patterns.domain: 论文、百科、法律文书、论坛等多种英文文本

patterns.name: 数字或日期表达
patterns.context: 数字、年份、日期、测量值或数量的局部表达中出现较强激活，但触发位置不一致。
patterns.domain: 科研摘要、百科、法律文书

patterns.name: 其他专名与术语片段
patterns.context: 少数段落在姓名、缩写或专业词中的局部子词上激活；未见统一的上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、百科、法律文书

en.concept: Doping in scientific texts
en.description: Most activations center on descriptions of doping in materials or systems, especially doped materials and their electronic, spin, optical, superconducting, molecular-device, or catalytic properties; accelerator experiments and bacterial adhesion also occur and are difficult to explain through this theme.

patterns.name: Material doping and doped states
patterns.context: Descriptions of doping in materials, systems, or compounds; often adjacent to elements, carrier types, bands, or physical properties.
patterns.domain: Condensed matter physics, materials science, chemistry, and related abstracts

patterns.name: Superconductivity and electronic states
patterns.context: Discusses carrier doping, density of states, Fermi level, or structural stability in superconducting materials.

patterns.name: Optical and band properties of doped materials
patterns.context: In-gap sub-bands and ultraviolet or visible luminescence in doped oxides.

patterns.name: Spintronics and transport timescales
patterns.context: Discusses electron scattering, spin polarization, and spintronic applications in doped multilayer systems.

patterns.name: Alkali-metal doping of fullerenes
patterns.context: Fullerenes doped with alkali metals, associated with electron transfer and excitation spectra.
patterns.domain: Molecular materials, spectroscopy, and electron-transfer research

patterns.name: Organic semiconductors and molecularly doped devices
patterns.context: Doping in molecular nanowires or polymers, along with field effects and hole transport.

patterns.name: Doped supports as catalyst supports
patterns.context: Gadolinium-doped titanium dioxide nanocrystals used as supports for gold nanoparticles; catalytic activity and diffusion limitations are discussed.

patterns.name: Description of a non-doping high-energy physics experiment
patterns.context: Neutrino beams, accelerator beamlines, and hadron production; no clear doping theme.

patterns.name: Bacterial binding to extracellular matrix
patterns.context: Compares bacterial strain binding to extracellular matrix proteins and its variation; no clear materials-doping theme.

9_2929.concept: 科学文本中的掺杂
9_2929.description: 多数激活集中在材料或体系的掺杂表述，尤其掺杂材料及其电子、自旋、光学、超导、分子器件或催化性质；另有加速器实验和细菌黏附语境，难以由该主题解释。

patterns.name: 材料掺杂与掺杂态
patterns.context: 材料、系统或化合物的掺杂描述；常与元素、载流子类型、能带或物性相邻。
patterns.domain: 凝聚态物理、材料科学、化学及相关摘要

patterns.name: 超导与电子态
patterns.context: 讨论超导材料的载流子掺杂、态密度、费米能级或结构稳定性。

patterns.name: 掺杂材料的光学与能带性质
patterns.context: 掺杂氧化物的能隙内亚带及紫外、可见发光。
patterns.domain: 材料光学、光致发光研究

patterns.name: 自旋电子学与输运时间尺度
patterns.context: 以掺杂多层体系为对象，讨论电子散射、自旋极化和自旋电子学应用。
patterns.domain: 自旋电子学、纳米器件物理

patterns.name: 富勒烯的碱金属掺杂
patterns.context: 富勒烯受碱金属掺杂，关联电子转移与激发光谱。
patterns.domain: 分子材料、光谱与电子转移研究

patterns.name: 有机半导体与分子掺杂器件
patterns.context: 分子纳米线或聚合物中的掺杂及场效应、空穴输运。

patterns.name: 掺杂载体作为催化剂载体
patterns.context: 钆掺杂二氧化钛纳米晶作为金纳米颗粒载体，讨论催化活性与扩散限制。

patterns.name: 非掺杂的高能物理实验描述
patterns.context: 中微子束、加速器束线及强子产生；没有明显掺杂主题。

patterns.name: 细菌与细胞外基质结合
patterns.context: 比较菌株与细胞外基质蛋白的结合及其变异；没有明显材料掺杂主题。
patterns.domain: 微生物学、生物医学摘要

en.concept: Probability and sequence questions in math problems
en.description: Primarily responds to probability problems involving drawing letters without replacement: sampling descriptions, letter-frequency tables, probability questions, and specified-letter or sequence events; weaker activation also occurs on the wording of sequence problems asking for the next term or the kth term.

patterns.name: Probability problems drawing letters without replacement
patterns.context: Describes drawing several letters from a set of letters or a letter-count table, followed by a probability question; sometimes continues across passages, with the preceding passage giving an answer or ending the problem.

patterns.name: Probability questions and target events
patterns.context: Asks for the probability of drawing a specified letter, letter combination, or sequence, often using a template for sampling without replacement.

patterns.name: Letter-frequency table notation
patterns.context: Uses curly braces to list letters and their counts as the sampling population; counts and letter combinations vary.
patterns.domain: Data representation in DM Mathematics probability problems

patterns.name: Specified letter strings or sequences
patterns.context: The probability event concerns a particular letter, consecutive string of letters, or ordered sequence; not every problem uses a frequency table.

patterns.name: Finding the next term in a sequence
patterns.context: Presents an integer sequence and asks for the next term, with negative numbers and likely sequence data nearby.

patterns.name: Finding the kth term of a polynomial
patterns.context: Provides several values and asks for the kth term of an expression or sequence; algebraic expressions appear in the context.

9_2929.concept: 数学题中的概率与数列提问
9_2929.description: 主要响应不放回抽取字母的概率题：抽样描述、字母频数表、概率提问及指定字母或序列事件；另对数列求下一项和求第k项的题目措辞有较弱激活。

patterns.name: 不放回抽字母的概率题
patterns.context: 描述从字母集合或字母计数表中抽取若干字母，后续询问概率；有时跨段延续，前段给答案或题目结尾

patterns.name: 概率提问与目标事件
patterns.context: 询问抽到指定字母、字母组合或序列的概率，常与不放回抽样题模板连用

patterns.name: 字母频数表记法
patterns.context: 用花括号列出字母及其数量，作为抽样总体；频数和字母组合变化
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 概率题中的数据表示

patterns.name: 指定字母串或序列
patterns.context: 概率事件指向特定字母、连续字母串或有序序列；并非每题都用频数表

patterns.name: 数列求下一项
patterns.context: 给出整数序列并要求推断后续项，周围含负数及疑似数列数据

patterns.name: 求多项式的第 k 项
patterns.context: 给出若干数值，询问某表达式或数列的第 k 项；上下文含代数式

en.concept: Local fragments in academic texts
en.description: Activation is scattered across papers in multiple disciplines: fragments following after, terms and abbreviations with internal subwords, academic syntactic words, and formulas, numbers, and a few domain-specific terms are all marked. Trigger positions are unstable, making a single semantic pattern difficult to identify.

patterns.name: Substrings following after
patterns.context: Words or phrases following after are marked in varied contexts, especially in prepositional phrases or descriptions of time and processes. The triggering words themselves are inconsistent.
patterns.domain: Academic body text and abstracts across disciplines

patterns.name: Internal fragments of terms and proper names
patterns.context: Activation falls on subwords in scientific terms, abbreviations, Latin species names, or formatting markers; many words are split into subword fragments, and the markings do not cover the full term.
patterns.domain: Biomedical science, microbiology, astrophysics, materials physics, and paper formatting

patterns.name: Connective and structural words
patterns.context: Several function words and common verbs are marked in academic sentences about methods, results, or formulas; the same word behaves inconsistently across passages.

patterns.name: Mathematics and formula formatting
patterns.context: In passages containing mathematical symbols, formula environments, or LaTeX formatting, activation appears on formula variables and nearby environments.

patterns.name: Number and unit formats
patterns.context: Numbers, units, or formatted expressions with units appear in experimental data or descriptions of paper layout.

patterns.name: Local words in proper names
patterns.context: Terms occur inside method names or abbreviations; trigger positions are fragmented and cannot be reduced to a single stable word meaning.

patterns.name: Walking and group behavior descriptions
patterns.context: Describes mobile subjects walking together and entering a crowded place.
patterns.domain: Behavioral data research on mobile agents

patterns.name: Body parts and irradiation
patterns.context: Medical descriptions of partial-body irradiation and its effect on hematopoietic stem-cell migration.

patterns.name: Biological experimental subjects and membrane proteins
patterns.context: Describes heterologous expression of a plant plasma-membrane proton pump in yeast and transport assays.

patterns.name: Astrophysical phenomenon
patterns.context: Bright X-ray flares in gamma-ray burst afterglows.

9_2929.concept: 学术文本局部片段
9_2929.description: 激活分散于多学科论文文本：after 后续片段、术语及缩写内部子词、学术句法词，以及公式、数字和少数领域专属词均有标记。各片段触发位置不稳定，难以用单一语义模式解释。

patterns.name: after 后的子串
patterns.trigger: «after» 后紧接的 token 或子串，如 «continuous»、«glow»、«cTBS»、«heter»、«subjects»、«a»、«expanding»、«the»、«various»
patterns.context: 不同上下文中，after 后的词或词组被标记；尤其出现于介词短语或时间/过程描述中。触发词本身并不一致。
patterns.domain: 跨学科论文正文及摘要

patterns.name: 术语及专名内部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在科学名词、缩写、拉丁学名或排版标记的若干子词上；许多词被分词拆开，标记并不覆盖完整术语。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、微生物学、天体物理、材料物理及论文排版

patterns.name: 片段衔接与结构词
patterns.context: 在方法、结果或公式说明等学术句子中，若干功能词和普通动词被标记；同词在不同片段中的表现并不一致。

patterns.name: 数学与公式排版
patterns.context: 含数学符号、公式环境或 LaTeX 排版的片段中，公式变量及环境附近出现激活。

patterns.name: 数值与单位格式
patterns.context: 数字、单位或带单位的排版片段出现在实验数据或论文版式描述中。

patterns.name: 专名中的局部字词
patterns.context: 词项位于方法名称或缩写内部，具体触发位置呈碎片化，无法归结为单个稳定词义。
patterns.domain: 生物医学方法及技术缩写

patterns.name: 步行与群体行为描述
patterns.context: 描述移动受试者共同步行并进入拥挤场所的行为。
patterns.domain: 移动主体行为数据研究

patterns.name: 身体部位与照射
patterns.context: 部分身体照射及其对造血干细胞迁移影响的医学表述。
patterns.domain: 放射生物学或医学摘要

patterns.name: 生物实验对象与膜蛋白
patterns.context: 描述植物质膜质子泵在酵母中异源表达及运输测定。
patterns.domain: 植物生理学与生物化学

patterns.name: 天体物理现象
patterns.context: 伽马射线暴余辉中的明亮 X 射线耀发。

en.concept: after and subsequent events
en.description: The strongest cross-domain trigger is after within sentences, often introducing circumstances following a prior event, procedure, administration, or stimulus. There are also local activations on the angular expression by 45° and on namely.

patterns.name: Sentence-internal “after” trigger
patterns.context: Appears before a subsequent event, operation, or result in a longer sentence or technical statement; capitalization does not affect the trigger.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: historical narratives, paper abstracts, mathematics, and physics texts

patterns.name: Rescue narrative after a historical event
patterns.context: “after” introduces events following damage to a ship; the preceding text describes the actions of the rescue vessel.

patterns.name: after in a bibliography entry
patterns.context: Appears in a LaTeX/BibTeX-style bibliography entry, next to author or title information.

patterns.name: after in paper results or methods
patterns.context: “after” introduces a signal, field, or result following the completion of a treatment step or operation.
patterns.domain: ArXiv astrophysics and theoretical physics texts; Wikipedia science entries

patterns.name: after in medical research
patterns.context: “after” introduces measurements, changes, or research processes following treatment, administration, an observation period, or stimulation.

patterns.name: Angular description in quantum optics
patterns.context: Describes the angle of rotation of polarization modes by a wave plate; this passage does not contain after, and activation concentrates near the angle and explanatory connective.

9_2929.concept: after及后续事件
9_2929.description: 最强且跨领域的触发是句中 after，常引出此前事件、处理、给药或刺激之后的情况；此外有角度表达 by 45°、namely 的局部激活。

patterns.name: 句中“after”触发
patterns.context: 在较长句子或技术性陈述中，出现在后续事件、操作或结果之前；大小写不影响触发。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：历史叙述、论文摘要、数学与物理文本

patterns.name: 历史事件后的救援叙述
patterns.trigger: «after»10 that high-speed transport had suffered a
patterns.context: “after”引出船只受损之后的事件，前文叙述援助船只行动。

patterns.name: 参考文献条目中的 after
patterns.context: 出现在 LaTeX/BibTeX 风格文献条目中，紧邻作者或标题信息。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学论文参考文献

patterns.name: 论文结果或方法中的 after
patterns.context: “after”引出处理步骤或操作完成后的信号、场或结果。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 天体物理、理论物理文本；Wikipedia 科学条目

patterns.name: 医学研究中的 after
patterns.context: “after”引出治疗、给药、观察期或刺激后的测量、变化或研究过程。

patterns.name: 量子光学中的角度描述
patterns.context: 描述波片对偏振模式的旋转角度；该段未标记 after，激活集中在角度与解释性连接词附近。

en.concept: Markers of subsequent stages
en.description: Activation centers on after and the words that follow it, especially structures of the form after + time, event noun, or gerund; these mark sequence, outcomes after an operation, or narrative stages, and occur across scientific and general explanatory texts.

patterns.name: after followed by a time or process stage
patterns.context: Activates when describing event order, a state after an operation, or the progression of a derivation or narrative to a later stage; common structure: after + time/action/process.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: physics, mathematics, astronomy, science news, and formal proof texts

patterns.name: after followed by a gerund or operation
patterns.context: after introduces a preceding operation, followed by a description of the resulting expression, observation, or signal.

patterns.name: after followed by a time or event noun
patterns.context: after is followed by a noun phrase, relational word, or process noun marking a time point, condition, or narrative stage; [10] personifies the proof process.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, astronomy, and proof/encyclopedia narratives

patterns.name: Other nearby contexts
patterns.context: The passage as a whole discusses an absorption signal in radio astronomy; activation may relate to the after construction, but nearby frequency, absorption, and signal descriptions make its independent contribution unclear.

9_2929.concept: 后续阶段标记
9_2929.description: 激活集中在 after 及其后续词，尤其 after + 时间、事件名词或动名词的结构；用于标记先后关系、操作完成后的结果或叙述阶段，跨科学与一般说明文本出现。

patterns.name: after 后接时间或过程阶段
patterns.context: 在描述事件发生的先后、某操作完成后状态，或推导/叙述推进到后续阶段时激活；常见结构为 after + 时间/动作/过程。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：物理、数学、天文学、科学新闻及形式化证明文本

patterns.name: after 后接动名词或操作
patterns.context: after 引出先行操作，后文描述操作后的表达式、观测结果或信号。

patterns.name: after 后接时间或事件名词
patterns.context: after 后接名词短语、关系词或过程名词，标出时间点、条件或叙述阶段；[10]为拟人化的证明过程叙述。
patterns.domain: 科学论文、天文学及证明/百科叙述

patterns.name: 其他邻近语境
patterns.trigger: 无法从可见触发词充分解释；[4]另有 «78» «MHz» absorption profile，«after»10 位于“after subtracting”结构中
patterns.context: 该段整体讨论射电天文学中的吸收信号；激活可能与 after 结构有关，但附近还包含频率、吸收和信号描述，无法确定其独立贡献。

en.concept: Procedural and temporal transitions in papers
en.description: Activations are distributed across two common structures: administration, treatment, and “within the first” time windows in biomedical experiments; and subsequent steps introduced by “after” and nearby formulas in theoretical physics texts. Other examples include dose-effect titles, quantum optics apparatus, and descriptions of quantum gas loading.

patterns.name: within the first in temporal or numerical statements
patterns.context: Describes administration, observation, or an experimental time window, especially “within the first [number] [time unit]”; [1] also has “within the first 24 h”, and [2] has “within the first 30 minutes”.

patterns.name: Subsequent steps introduced by after
patterns.context: A preceding passage gives a treatment, calculation, or experimental step, followed by after to introduce what happens or is done next; occurs in biomedical experiments and theoretical physics discussions.

patterns.name: Descriptions of administration and experimental treatment
patterns.context: Describes the method of administration, a drug or intervention, and its relation to an injury model in animal experiments; activation also falls on the administration action and nearby experimental time and dosage terms.

patterns.name: Dose-effect statement in a bracketed title
patterns.context: A title summarizes the effects of a drug on multiple organs or tissues in terms of a dose-effect relationship.

patterns.name: Mathematical formulas and nearby explanations
patterns.context: Activation occurs in formulas, equation numbers, or accompanying explanations, involving various theoretical topics such as derivations, tensors, and field expansions; the formula topics are not uniform.

patterns.name: Experimental apparatus and quantum optics descriptions
patterns.context: Describes a wave plate rotating the polarization of a specific mode, with quantum states and angle notation.

patterns.name: Loading a quantum gas in an experiment
patterns.context: Describes the experimental process of loading a spin-polarized quantum degenerate Fermi gas into a three-dimensional optical lattice.

9_2929.concept: 论文中的步骤与时间衔接表达
9_2929.description: 激活分散于两类常见结构：生物医学实验中给药、处理及“within the first”时间窗；理论物理文本中“after”引出的后续步骤及公式邻近内容。另见剂量效应标题、量子光学装置和量子气体装载描述。

patterns.name: 时间或数值陈述中的 within the first
patterns.trigger: «within»« the»« first»，以及同段的时间范围表达
patterns.context: 在描述给药、观察或实验时间窗时，尤其是“within the first [数值] [时间单位]”；[1] 还有“within the first 24 h”，[2] 有“within the first 30 minutes”。

patterns.name: after 引出的后续步骤
patterns.context: 前文给出处理、计算或实验步骤，随后用 after 转入之后发生或进行的步骤；出现于生物医学实验和理论物理论述中。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、理论物理论文

patterns.name: 给药与实验处理描述
patterns.trigger: «administered»、«given»，以及剂量、注射或处理相关表达
patterns.context: 描述动物实验中的给药方式、药物或干预及其与损伤模型的关系；激活也落在给药动作及周边实验时间、剂量词上。

patterns.name: 方括号标题中的剂量效应表述
patterns.context: 标题以剂量—效应关系概括药物对多个器官或组织的影响。

patterns.name: 数学公式及其邻近公式说明
patterns.trigger: 公式符号、LaTeX 数学表达式，以及其邻近的“Eq.”、“compact form”等文字
patterns.context: 激活出现在公式、公式编号或公式前后的说明中，涉及推导、张量、场展开等多种理论内容；公式主题并不统一。

patterns.name: 实验装置与量子光学描述
patterns.context: 描述波片对特定模式的偏振进行旋转，包含量子态和角度记法。

patterns.name: 实验装载量子气体
patterns.context: 描述将自旋极化的量子简并费米气体装入三维光学晶格的实验过程。

en.concept: Subsequent steps or time introduced by after
en.description: In most passages, after appears after formulas, equations, or derivation steps, especially in after expanding, after redefining, after subtracting, and after which; a few medical passages describe time windows after administration or injury. Several other technical passages have no clear shared trigger pattern.

patterns.name: after clauses following mathematical expressions
patterns.context: “after” introduces an operation, transformation, or derivation condition, often near formula formatting; the word itself and adjacent text activate.

patterns.name: after in paper method descriptions
patterns.context: Describes steps or sequence in a formula derivation; often preceded by formulas, variables, or equation numbers.

patterns.name: Time windows and experimental time points
patterns.context: after combines with a specific time interval to describe an observation window following administration or injury.

patterns.name: After followed by research or algorithm terms
patterns.context: Expressions of temporal or methodological order, followed by expanding the fields, which Eq may be, redefining, subtracting, or which Eq may be; paragraph 6 mentions First Reaction Time Algorithm, which does not form a phrase directly with after.

patterns.name: Technical contexts without the main trigger word
patterns.context: Involves Jiang’s work, CDW-E, Hamiltonian matrix, tensor expressions, or biomedical drug and injury descriptions; activation may arise from incomplete excerpts or other local features.

9_2929.concept: after 引出的后续步骤或时间
9_2929.description: 多数片段在公式、方程或推导步骤后出现 after，尤其是 after expanding、after redefining、after subtracting、after which；少数医学片段描述给药或损伤后的时间窗口。另有若干技术段落没有清楚的共同触发模式。

patterns.name: 数学表达式后的 after 从句
patterns.context: “after”引出操作、变换或推导条件，常见于公式排版附近；词本身及相邻文字激活。

patterns.name: 论文方法描述中的 after
patterns.context: 描述公式推导中的步骤或先后顺序；前面常有公式、变量或方程编号。

patterns.name: 时间窗口与实验时间点
patterns.context: after 与具体时间段结合，描述给药或损伤后的实验观察窗口。

patterns.name: After 后接研究或算法名词
patterns.context: 时间或方法顺序表达，后接 expanding the fields、which Eq may be、redefining、subtracting、which Eq may be 等；第6段则出现 First Reaction Time Algorithm，但不与 after 直接构成短语。

patterns.name: 未见主触发词的技术性上下文
patterns.context: 涉及 Jiang’s work、CDW-E、Hamiltonian matrix、张量表达式，或生物医学药物与损伤描述；激活可能来自不完整截取或其他局部特征。

en.concept: none
en.description: Activations are distributed across formulas, technical proper names, and physics vocabulary in scientific papers, as well as magnetic-field descriptions, popular astronomy, unit-conversion questions, medical abstracts, and citation markers; no clear cross-domain shared feature is apparent.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and formula boundaries
patterns.context: Near formulas, equations, or mathematical notation; some activations fall on equal signs, formula endings, or mathematical symbols within formulas.

patterns.name: Technical terms or proper names in scientific texts
patterns.context: Near titles, proper names, terminology, or compound words in technical papers; activation locations are not consistent.

patterns.name: Physics and astronomy vocabulary
patterns.context: In scientific descriptions involving flows, modes, magnetic fields, particles, or stars, often adjacent to formulas or technical terminology.
patterns.domain: Physics and astronomy papers and popular science entries

patterns.name: Magnetic-field and external-field descriptions
patterns.context: When directly discussing magnetic fields or applied constant magnetic fields; this pattern appears in only two passages.

patterns.name: Astronomical observatories and cosmic history
patterns.context: In popular science texts introducing radio astronomy facilities or the history of cosmic reionization.

patterns.name: Unit conversions and number sequences
patterns.context: A unit-conversion question is posed, followed by a numerical answer; activation concentrates on numbers, units, or question wording.

patterns.name: Organs and time in a medical abstract
patterns.context: The abstract reports a drug's effect on digestive organs and specifies the assessment time; this appears in only one passage.

patterns.name: Citation and book markers
patterns.context: Near literature citations or footnote markers in paper text; activation also falls on adjacent author names and terminology.

9_2929.concept: none
9_2929.description: 激活分布于科学论文的公式、技术专名及物理词汇，也见于磁场表述、天文科普、单位换算题、医学摘要和引用标记；跨领域共享特征不明确。

patterns.name: 数学符号与公式边界
patterns.context: 公式、方程或数学标记附近；个别激活落在等号、公式结束处或公式中的数学符号上。

patterns.name: 科技文中的技术名词或专名
patterns.context: 技术论文的标题、专名、术语或复合词附近，激活位置并不固定。

patterns.name: 物理与天文学词汇
patterns.context: 涉及流动、模式、磁场、粒子或恒星的科学叙述中，常与公式或专业术语相邻。
patterns.domain: 物理、天文学论文及科普条目

patterns.name: 磁场及外场表述
patterns.context: 直接讨论磁场或外加恒定磁场时；本模式仅见于两个片段。

patterns.name: 天文观测机构与宇宙史
patterns.context: 介绍射电天文观测设施或宇宙再电离历史的科普文本中。

patterns.name: 单位换算与数字序列
patterns.context: 以问句提出单位换算题，随后给出数字答案；激活集中在数字、单位或题目措辞上。

patterns.name: 医学摘要中的器官与时间
patterns.context: 摘要报告药物对消化器官的作用，并说明评估时间；只在此片段出现。

patterns.name: 引用与书目标记
patterns.context: 论文正文中的文献引用或脚注标记附近；激活也落在相邻作者名、术语上。

en.concept: none
en.description: Mixed activation patterns: function words and definite articles in technical texts, formulas and derivation formatting, fragments of specialized terms, section headings, and ordinal numbers in news. Multiple patterns co-occur, making it difficult to assign a single semantic feature.

patterns.name: Technical prose function word “by”
patterns.context: Appears in technical papers linking a method, calculation, or simulation to the object it depends on; [1] also has the nearby collocation « based on».

patterns.name: Symbols and mathematical formatting in formulas and derivations
patterns.context: Formulas, equation derivations, or explanatory text following formulas; activation is distributed around mathematical symbols and some derivation terms.

patterns.name: “the” and nearby definite articles
patterns.context: The definite article before noun phrases in scientific or medical English; [1] also marks the article after « on» and « around».

patterns.name: “of” in medical titles
patterns.context: Connects a “dose-response relationship” with its subject in medical literature titles; activation also falls on drug names and anatomical terms.

patterns.name: Fragments within specialized terms
patterns.context: Activation falls on cross-word fragments or within specialized words, possibly associated with rare terms or tokenization boundaries; no consistent semantic condition is evident.

patterns.name: Section headings and flow descriptions
patterns.context: The “Linear Modes” section heading and descriptions of piecewise linear equilibrium flow, spatial directions, and finite regions.

patterns.name: Ordinal numbers in news text
patterns.context: A news account discusses redefining success with the phrase «the first two metrics»; «first» activates markedly more than neighboring words.

9_2929.concept: none
9_2929.description: 激活模式混杂：技术文本中的功能词和定冠词、公式及推导排版、专业术语片段、章节标题，以及新闻中的序数词。多个模式并存，难以归为单一语义特征。

patterns.name: 技术文体中的功能词“by”
patterns.context: 出现在技术论文中，连接方法、计算或模拟与其所依赖的对象；[1]另有« based on»的近邻搭配。

patterns.name: 公式及推导中的符号/数学排版
patterns.context: 公式、方程推导或公式后的说明文字，激活散布于数学符号及部分推导词周围。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学/理论物理论文

patterns.name: “the”及定冠词附近
patterns.context: 科技或医学英语中名词短语前的定冠词；[1]在« on»、« around»后也标记了冠词。

patterns.name: 医学标题中的“of”
patterns.context: 医学文献标题中连接“剂量-效应关系”和研究对象；激活同时落在药名及解剖词上。

patterns.name: 专业术语内部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在跨词片段或专业词内部，可能与罕见术语、分词边界有关，未见统一语义条件。

patterns.name: 章节标题与流动描述
patterns.context: “Linear Modes”章节标题及对分段线性平衡流、空间方向和有限区域的描述。

patterns.name: 新闻文本中的序数词
patterns.context: 新闻叙述谈到重新定义成功时，短语为«the first two metrics»；«first»显著高于邻近词。

en.concept: Local fragments in technical texts
en.description: Activations span papers, medicine, place-name lists, and code, often falling on word-internal subwords, proper names, structural markers, and numbers/constants. There is no single stable topic; technical texts, formatting, proper names, and code fragments all trigger activation.

patterns.name: Fragmentary markers in technical documents
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across scientific paper text, section headings, references, and code constants; many markers are not complete semantic words, and trigger locations vary considerably across passages.

patterns.name: Specific scientific word fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in physics or mathematics papers, often alongside formulas, abbreviations, and section structure; activation falls on word fragments and method/derivation vocabulary.

patterns.name: Title and section-structure words
patterns.context: Near paper metadata, titles, or section headings; section markers may appear alongside mathematical content in the body.

patterns.name: Place names and their internal fragments
patterns.context: In place-name lists or descriptions of geographic distribution in natural history texts; activation often falls within proper names.

patterns.name: Code identifiers and hexadecimal constants
patterns.context: Constant definitions, identifiers, and value assignments in code; triggers concentrate on uppercase/camelCase identifiers and hexadecimal strings.

patterns.name: Numerical timing and complication descriptions
patterns.context: Clinical narrative about the risk and timing of stent thrombosis complications.

patterns.name: Structural fragments in formula derivations
patterns.context: Derivation statements involving variable definitions and substituting derivatives into equations, interspersed with LaTeX formulas and equation numbers.

patterns.name: Taxonomic names and citation markers
patterns.context: Near species binomials, author names, and literature citations in descriptions of species distribution.

patterns.name: Garbled or incomplete word forms
patterns.context: Text is split into subwords, with activation on incomplete spelling fragments; it is difficult to establish that these fragments themselves form a consistent semantic feature.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia place-name lists and mixed corpora

9_2929.concept: 技术文本中的局部片段
9_2929.description: 激活跨论文、医学、地名清单与代码，常落在词内子词、专名、结构标记及数字/常量上。没有稳定的单一主题；技术文本与格式、专名和代码碎片均有触发。

patterns.name: 技术文档中的碎片化标记
patterns.trigger: 多处标记落在词内或标点、空格、数字上，如«\]»、«↵»、«.»、«a»、«=»、«0x»中的局部
patterns.context: 激活散布于科学论文正文、章节标题、参考文献周边及代码常量中；不少标记不是完整语义词，且各段触发位置差异很大

patterns.name: 特定科学词汇片段
patterns.context: 出现于物理或数学论文中，常伴随公式、缩写、章节结构；激活在词内片段和方法/推导词汇上

patterns.name: 标题与章节结构词
patterns.context: 论文元数据、标题或章节标题附近；章节标记可与正文中的数学内容并存
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文元数据与结构

patterns.name: 地名及其词内片段
patterns.context: 地名列表或自然史文本中的地理分布描述，激活常截在专名内部
patterns.domain: 地名清单、分类学/自然史

patterns.name: 代码标识符与十六进制常量
patterns.context: 代码中的常量定义、标识符和值赋值；触发集中于大写/驼峰标识符和十六进制位串

patterns.name: 数字时间与并发症表述
patterns.context: 支架血栓并发症风险及发生时间的临床叙述

patterns.name: 公式推导中的结构性片段
patterns.context: 围绕变量定义、导数代入方程的推导语句，夹杂 LaTeX 公式和方程编号

patterns.name: 分类学名称及引文标记
patterns.context: 物种学名、作者名与文献引用附近，描述物种分布

patterns.name: 乱码或不完整词形
patterns.context: 文本被切分为子词，激活在不完整拼写片段上，难以确认这些片段自身构成一致语义特征
patterns.domain: 百科地名列表及混合语料

en.concept: none
en.description: Activation is distributed across academic paper structure markers and terminology, numbers and operators in math problems, web URLs, and mixed metadata such as addresses and titles. The commonality is weak, making it difficult to reduce the pattern to a single stable word sense or semantic category.

patterns.name: Numbers and symbols in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Near formulas, equations, or calculation problems; activation is distributed across numbers, operators, and variables, rather than being limited to a specific mathematical symbol
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics, algebra and number-base exercises

patterns.name: Paper structure markers and section boundaries
patterns.context: Near titles, sections, or metadata markers in academic papers; markers and boundary text activate

patterns.name: Technical terms and proper nouns
patterns.context: Near specialized terms, people’s names, or compound nouns in scientific papers; activation falls on some tokens within terms
patterns.domain: Statistics, physics, mathematics, and particle physics papers

patterns.name: Links and mixed strings
patterns.context: Local character fragments activate in non-prose strings such as web URLs, paths, and identifiers

patterns.name: Mixed language and numerical expressions
patterns.context: Addresses and title fields in paper metadata, as well as written explanations of number-base conversions in problems; activation covers numbers and field fragments in mixed text

9_2929.concept: none
9_2929.description: 激活分布在学术论文的结构标记与术语、数学题中的数字和运算符、网页URL，以及地址和标题等混合元数据上。共性较弱，难以归结为单一稳定的词义或语义类别。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的数字与符号
patterns.context: 公式、方程或计算题附近；激活散布于数字、运算符和变量，不局限于某个特定数学符号

patterns.name: 论文结构标记与分节边界
patterns.context: 学术论文的标题、章节或元数据标记附近；标记与边界文本被激活

patterns.name: 技术名词与专名
patterns.context: 科学论文中专门术语、人物名或复合名词附近；激活落在术语内部的部分 token 上
patterns.domain: 统计、物理、数学与粒子物理论文

patterns.name: 链接及其混杂字符串
patterns.context: 网页 URL、路径和标识符等非散文字符串中，局部字符片段激活

patterns.name: 语言与数值表述混合
patterns.context: 论文元数据中的地址、标题字段，以及题目里以文字说明的进制转换；激活覆盖混合文本中的数字和字段片段

en.concept: Subwords and symbol fragments in text
en.description: Activations cover common transitions in academic papers, operators and numbers in algebra problems, Polish parliamentary word fragments, and subword fragments in Latin taxonomic names and paper metadata; across languages and styles, no single stable trigger feature is apparent.

patterns.name: English transitions and paper narrative
patterns.context: Appears in English academic paper text, especially statements of research aims or paper structure such as “In the present paper/work we…”; some marked words are very common, and triggering seems to depend on this fixed context.

patterns.name: Symbols and numbers in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Appears in equations, polynomials, algebra problems, or integer decision problems; activation is distributed across operators, numbers, and a few variables, with no unique stable mathematical-symbol trigger condition apparent.

patterns.name: Polish parliamentary word-form fragments
patterns.context: Polish words are split into subword fragments, appearing in statements by agenda chairs and introductory sentences in parliamentary reports; activation concentrates on word-internal fragments rather than a single clearly identifiable semantic word.

patterns.name: Latin word fragments in zoological names
patterns.context: Appears near the species name “Diplacus rupicola”, followed by an English common name; activation falls on subword fragments of the genus and specific epithet.

patterns.name: Genus names and specific epithets in animal taxonomies
patterns.context: Latinized species binomials recur in continuous lists, accompanied by author names and years; activation covers multiple subword fragments within the names.

patterns.name: Names and fields in author metadata
patterns.context: Appears in paper author information and metadata fields; author names contain Polish diacritics, and activation involves name-character fragments and the “title” field.

9_2929.concept: 文本中的子词与符号片段
9_2929.description: 激活涵盖学术论文常见衔接语、代数题中的运算符与数值、波兰语议会词片段，以及拉丁分类学名称和论文元数据中的子词片段；跨语种、跨文体，未见单一稳定触发特征。

patterns.name: 英语衔接词与论文叙述
patterns.trigger: « the»、« present»、« paper»、« we»、« introduce»、« focus»、« work»
patterns.context: 出现在英语学术论文正文中，尤其是“In the present paper/work we…”一类研究目标或文章结构表述；有些被标记词本身很常见，触发似乎依赖这个固定语境。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的符号与数字
patterns.context: 出现在方程、多项式、代数题或整数判定问题中；激活分布在运算符、数字以及少量变量周围，未显示出唯一稳定的数学符号触发条件。

patterns.name: 波兰语议会词形片段
patterns.context: 波兰语词被拆成子词片段，出现在议程主持人发言及议会报告介绍句中；激活集中在词内片段而非清晰可辨的单一语义词。

patterns.name: 动物学名称中的拉丁词片段
patterns.context: 出现在物种名称“Diplacus rupicola”附近，随后接英文俗名；激活落在属名和种加词的子词片段上。

patterns.name: 动物分类名录中的属名与种加词
patterns.context: 拉丁化的物种学名在连续名录中重复出现，并伴随作者姓名和年份；激活覆盖名称内部的多个子词片段。

patterns.name: 作者元数据中的姓名与字段
patterns.context: 出现在论文作者信息及元数据字段中，作者姓名含波兰语变音符号；激活涉及姓名字符片段和“title”字段。

en.concept: Mathematics and specialized terms/subwords
en.description: Activation spans mathematical expressions and numbers, segmented place and personal names, and specialized terms in physics, numerical computation, and group theory; multiple contexts co-occur, with some activation falling on subword fragments.

patterns.name: Mathematical expressions and numerical operations
patterns.context: Numbers, operators, and mathematical terms intermix in math problems, simplification expressions, or numerical calculations; includes expressions with radicals and integer tests.

patterns.name: Segmented place and personal names
patterns.context: Personal names, place names, or list entries are split into multiple subword fragments; activation falls on different fragments of the names.

patterns.name: Physics terminology and paper prose
patterns.context: Academic paper passages describing interactions between phonons, electrons, and vibrational modes; activation is distributed across terms and some ordinary prose words.

patterns.name: Graphene model terminology
patterns.context: Introduces the continuum model of twisted double bilayer graphene; activation appears around specialized terms and segmented material names.

patterns.name: Mathematical software and equation code
patterns.context: Discusses numerical checks of approximations and provides Mathematica code for solving partial differential equations; activation occurs near code markers and technical terms.

patterns.name: Group representation theory terms and proper nouns
patterns.context: Introduces group representation theory over finite rings and includes a mathematician’s surname split into subwords.

9_2929.concept: 数学及专业术语/子词
9_2929.description: 激活涵盖数学算式与数值、拆分的地名人名，以及物理、数值计算和群论中的专业术语；多种语境并存，部分激活落在子词片段上。

patterns.name: 数学表达式与数字运算
patterns.context: 数学题、化简式或数值计算中，数字、运算符和数学术语交错出现；包括带根式的表达式及整数判定。

patterns.name: 拆分的地名与人名
patterns.context: 人名、地名或列表条目被拆成多个子词片段；激活落在名称的不同片段上。

patterns.name: 物理学术语与论文叙述
patterns.context: 描述声子、电子与振动模式相互作用的学术论文段落，激活分布在术语及部分普通叙述词上。

patterns.name: 石墨烯模型术语
patterns.context: 介绍扭转双双层石墨烯连续模型，专业名词和被拆分的材料名称周围均有激活。

patterns.name: 数学软件与方程代码
patterns.context: 讨论近似的数值检验，并给出 Mathematica 求解偏微分方程的代码；代码标记和技术词附近激活。

patterns.name: 群表示论术语及专名
patterns.context: 介绍有限环上的群表示论，并出现被拆成子词的数学家姓氏。

en.concept: Research-abstract introductions and common text fragments
en.description: Primarily responds to stock phrases such as “In this investigation/study” that introduce research in biomedical abstracts; scattered activations also occur on function words in academic sentences, LaTeX fragments, mathematical symbols, and code identifiers.

patterns.name: Introductions to investigations/experiments in research papers
patterns.context: Biomedical abstracts first introduce background, a knowledge gap, or prior findings, then use these phrases to introduce the current study; activation concentrates on the introductory phrase and nearby words.

patterns.name: English function words and boundary fragments
patterns.context: High-frequency English function words, prepositions, articles, or common phrase fragments in academic sentences are marked; no stable, specific semantic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Mathematical/LaTeX formulas and formatting fragments
patterns.context: In formulas, figure references, and LaTeX-style mathematical formatting, markers fall on commands, variables, or short common strings.

patterns.name: Number sequences and operators in arithmetic expressions
patterns.context: In short number strings, arithmetic problems, or algebraic expressions, activation falls near symbols and numbers; there is insufficient evidence to identify a more specific numerical pattern.

patterns.name: Punctuation and name fragments in code identifiers
patterns.context: In configuration or code-style lists, markers appear on colons and local fragments of camelCase identifiers; this differs from research-abstract introductory phrases.

9_2929.concept: 研究摘要引入语及常见文本片段
9_2929.description: 主要响应生物医学摘要引入研究的“In this investigation/study”一类套语；另在学术语句功能词、LaTeX片段、数学符号及代码标识符中出现分散激活。

patterns.name: 研究论文中的调查/实验引入语
patterns.trigger: “In this investigation,”、“In this study,”、“In the present study”
patterns.context: 生物医学摘要先介绍研究背景、知识缺口或既有发现，随后用这些短语引出本文研究；激活集中在引入短语及其邻近词。

patterns.name: 英语功能词及其边界片段
patterns.trigger: “interaction”中的“« interaction»”、“« in»”、“« small»”、“« between»”、“« by»”、“« a»”、“« this»”
patterns.context: 英语学术语句中的高频虚词、介词、冠词或常见搭配片段被标记；未见稳定、特定的语义条件。

patterns.name: 数学/LaTeX 公式与排版片段
patterns.context: 公式、图示引用和 LaTeX 风格的数学排版中，标记落在命令、变量或短常见字符串上。

patterns.name: 数字序列与算术表达式中的运算符
patterns.context: 短数字串、算术题或代数表达式中，激活落在符号与数字附近；没有足够证据确定更具体的数值模式。

patterns.name: 代码标识符中的标点与名称片段
patterns.context: 配置或代码式清单中，标记出现在冒号以及 camelCase 标识符的局部片段；与论文摘要引入语不同。

en.concept: “First order” academic terminology and miscellaneous patterns
en.description: The most stable signal is “first order” in papers, especially to describe methods, dynamics, or equations in mathematics, physics, and engineering. Other sporadic patterns include physics vibrational-mode terms, number problems, Polish and German proper-name lists, and biostatistics terminology.

patterns.name: “first order” terminology
patterns.context: The phrase “first order” is marked in technical descriptions of numerical, control, or mathematical methods/models; it is followed by objects such as methods, dynamics, or ODEs.

patterns.name: Phonons and vibrational modes in physics
patterns.context: Discusses phonons, vibrational modes, electron interactions, or vibrational density of states; activation falls near related terminology.

patterns.name: Numerical computation and model derivation language
patterns.context: Paper prose describes computational methods, equation derivations, or models; in addition to “first order,” other methodological terms are also marked.

patterns.name: Fragmented Polish text
patterns.context: Polish sentences are segmented into subword fragments, with activation concentrated on fragments of Christmas-related words; this differs from the technical context of the other passages.

patterns.name: Numbers and unit conversions in math problems
patterns.context: Number strings, unit-conversion instructions, or problem wording are marked in exercises and answers.

patterns.name: Fragments in German place-name lists
patterns.context: German place names are listed line by line; activation falls on subword fragments of proper nouns and on hyphens.

patterns.name: Gene expression statistical modeling
patterns.context: Describes overdispersion in gene expression counts and models it with a negative binomial distribution; activation covers the distribution name and syntactic connectives.

patterns.name: General academic prose fragments
patterns.context: Some common function words in technical papers are also weakly marked, without sufficiently consistent local trigger conditions.

9_2929.concept: first order学术术语及杂项
9_2929.description: 最稳定的信号是论文中的“first order”，尤其用于描述数学、物理和工程中的方法、动力学或方程；另有物理振动态术语，以及数字题、波兰语和德语专名列表、生物统计术语等零散模式。

patterns.name: “first order”术语
patterns.context: 数值、控制或数学方法/模型的技术表述中，短语“first order”被标记；后接 methods、dynamics、ODEs 等对象。

patterns.name: 物理中的声子与振动态
patterns.context: 讨论声子、振动态、电子相互作用或振动态密度；激活落在相关术语附近。

patterns.name: 数值计算与模型推导用语
patterns.context: 论文叙述计算方法、推导方程或模型；除“first order”外，也有其他方法论词汇被标记。

patterns.name: 波兰语字符碎片化文本
patterns.context: 波兰语句子被切分为子词片段，激活集中在圣诞节相关词语片段上；与其余段落的技术语境不同。

patterns.name: 数学题中的数字与单位换算
patterns.context: 练习题及答案中，数字串、单位换算指令或题目用词被标记。

patterns.name: 德语地名列表的片段
patterns.context: 德语地名逐行列举，激活落在专名的子词片段及连字符上。

patterns.name: 基因表达统计建模
patterns.context: 说明基因表达计数的过度离散，并用负二项分布建模；激活覆盖分布名称及句法连接词。

patterns.name: 一般学术行文词片段
patterns.context: 技术论文中若干常见功能词也有较弱标记，缺乏足够一致的局部触发条件。

en.concept: Preference for Polish place names and entry text
en.description: Primarily responds to English Wikipedia entries about Polish villages and their administrative templates, especially Gmina and word-internal fragments of Polish place names; activations also occur in ArXiv technical discussion, statements of paper aims, and lists of concentration-camp subcamps, with no shared trigger word to explain them all.

patterns.name: Polish village entry template
patterns.context: The village name may first appear as a title and then recur in the body; triggers concentrate on place names, village descriptions, and words in the gmina administrative template, especially “Gmina” and subsequent place names.
patterns.domain: English Wikipedia entries on Polish geography

patterns.name: Tokenization patterns in Polish place names
patterns.context: Focuses on character fragments at word-internal subword boundaries in Polish place names and administrative proper names; often co-occurs with village entry templates, but is not limited to template words.
patterns.domain: Polish place names in English Wikipedia

patterns.name: Technical narrative in scientific papers
patterns.context: Appears in English paper text involving physics, mathematics, or theoretical discussion; activation falls near common function words and terminology in sentences, without forming a pattern consistent with Polish village templates.

patterns.name: Paper-purpose statement construction
patterns.context: A sentence in a paper introduction or methods section explicitly states the paper's purpose; high activation mainly falls on the word “this”.

patterns.name: Polish place names in concentration-camp subcamp lists
patterns.context: A list title enumerates Nazi concentration-camp subcamps; it contains Polish place names but no village description template.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia list entry on a historical topic

9_2929.concept: 波兰地名与条目文本偏好
9_2929.description: 主要响应英文维基百科波兰村庄条目及其行政区模板，尤其是 Gmina 与波兰地名的词内片段；另在 ArXiv 技术论述、论文目的句和分营列表中也有激活，未见共同触发词可统一解释。

patterns.name: 波兰村庄条目模板
patterns.trigger: “is a village in the administrative district of Gmina …, within …”及村名、行政区名
patterns.context: 村名可能先以标题形式出现并在正文重复；触发点集中在地名、村庄介绍和 gmina 行政区模板词语，尤其是“Gmina”及其后续地名。
patterns.domain: 英文维基百科中的波兰地理条目

patterns.name: 波兰地名的分词形态
patterns.trigger: “Lip«nica»”“«Lublin»”“G«mina»”“«Ż»u”“K«ę»”等被切分标记的波兰地名或专名片段
patterns.context: 在波兰地名及其行政区专名中，关注词内子词边界处的字符片段；常与村庄条目模板共现，但并非只限模板词。
patterns.domain: 英文维基百科中的波兰地名

patterns.name: 科学论文中的技术性叙述
patterns.trigger: “interaction”“by means of a simple screened electrostatic potential”“is related to”“energy through a surface”等局部片段
patterns.context: 出现在英文论文正文中，涉及物理、数学或理论论述；激活落在句中常见功能词及术语附近，不构成与波兰村庄模板一致的模式。

patterns.name: 论文目的陈述句式
patterns.trigger: “The purpose of this paper is to provide a method”以及“this”
patterns.context: 论文引言或方法介绍中，出现明确说明文章目的的句式；高激活主要落在“this”一词。

patterns.name: 集中营分营名单中的波兰地名
patterns.context: 列表标题连续列举纳粹集中营分营；含波兰地名，但没有村庄介绍模板。
patterns.domain: 维基百科列表条目，历史主题

en.concept: Fragmented proper nouns and identifiers
en.description: The most prominent pattern is administrative templates, place names, and fragmented spellings in Polish village entries; there are also sporadic responses to Polish/French geographic entries, alphanumeric URL identifiers, and terminology, citations, or formula numbers in physics papers.

patterns.name: Token fragments in Polish place names
patterns.context: Polish village or administrative-area names appear in body text and titles, split into multiple subword tokens; activation often falls on Polish diacritics, place-name fragments, and administrative names.

patterns.name: Administrative templates in village entries
patterns.context: Village descriptions use a fixed sentence structure listing administrative levels such as gmina and county; activation centers on template words and administrative proper nouns.

patterns.name: Lists of Polish place names or historic camp names
patterns.context: Table of contents or lists contain place names from Central and Eastern Europe, especially Poland; these are not village-description templates.

patterns.name: Fixed sections and proper nouns in French geographic entries
patterns.context: Library descriptions, galleries, see-also, and references sections at the end of village entries; activation involves French proper nouns and section text.

patterns.name: Numbers and path fragments in URLs
patterns.context: Medium link paths or long strings of numbers and mixed alphanumeric identifiers are split into subwords; activation falls mainly on URL identifiers rather than link topics.

patterns.name: Black hole physics terms and citation markers
patterns.context: Describes black hole fingerprints and their dependence on background properties and laws of gravity, with literature citations; activation is pronounced on citation year markers.

patterns.name: Particle physics terminology and formula numbers
patterns.context: Discusses vector boson pairs, energy limits, and particle distributions in photons, with LaTeX formulas and citation markers.

9_2929.concept: 碎片化专名与标识符
9_2929.description: 最显著的是波兰村庄条目中的行政区模板、地名及其碎片化拼写；另对波兰/法国地理条目、URL字母数字标识符，以及物理论文的术语、引用或公式标号有零散响应。

patterns.name: 波兰地名中的分词片段
patterns.context: 波兰村庄或行政区名称在正文和标题中出现，名称被切分成多个子词 token；激活常落在波兰语变音字母、地名片段及行政名称附近。
patterns.domain: 英文 Wikipedia 地理条目

patterns.name: 村庄条目的行政区模板
patterns.trigger: “village« in» the« administrative» district« of» G«mina»…”、“within … County”
patterns.context: 村庄简介采用固定句式，列出 gmina、县等层级行政区；激活集中于模板词和行政区专名。

patterns.name: 波兰地名或历史营地名称列表
patterns.context: 条目目录或列表中出现中东欧、尤其波兰相关的地名；并非村庄简介模板。

patterns.name: 法国地理条目固定栏目与专名
patterns.context: 村庄条目末尾的图书馆介绍、图库、参见及参考资料栏目；激活涉及法国专名及栏目文字。

patterns.name: 网址中的数字与路径片段
patterns.context: Medium 链接路径或长串数字、字母数字混合标识符被子词切分；激活主要落在 URL 标识符，而非链接主题。

patterns.name: 黑洞物理学术语与引文标号
patterns.context: 描述黑洞指纹及其对背景性质和引力定律的依赖，并带有文献引用；激活明显落在年份引用标号。

patterns.name: 粒子物理术语及公式标号
patterns.context: 讨论矢量玻色子对、能量极限和光子中的粒子分布，并出现 LaTeX 公式及引用标号。

en.concept: Text structure and tokenization boundaries
en.description: Sporadic activation: line breaks, separators, metadata, and section markers in papers stand out; also seen on split names, math base-conversion problems, Yangian title terminology, citation keys, and news polling terms. Estonian parliamentary text does not reveal a common trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Line breaks and section/item structure markers
patterns.context: In academic text, especially near references, metadata, and section boundaries in ArXiv papers; activation concentrates on line breaks, separator lines, and following formatting characters, without requiring a specific topic
patterns.domain: ArXiv academic papers and structured text

patterns.name: Token fragments in proper names
patterns.context: Names split into multiple tokens, possibly with rare spellings or diacritics; activation falls on internal tokens of proper names
patterns.domain: Paper authors, citation names, and names in news text

patterns.name: Numeric and base-arithmetic formatting
patterns.context: Problems represent numbers in different bases and ask for calculations; some tokens in long digit strings and operators are marked

patterns.name: Technical term fragments in paper titles
patterns.context: Academic titles mention Yangian duality and free-boson representations; activation appears especially on split fragments of Yangian terminology

patterns.name: Poll in polling language
patterns.context: News articles discuss public attitudes toward same-sex marriage and polling sources

patterns.name: References and numbering formats
patterns.context: In-text citations include author names, citation keys, and years; appears alongside proper-name fragments

9_2929.concept: 文本结构与分词边界
9_2929.description: 激活分布零散：论文的换行、分隔符、元数据与章节标记较突出；另见被拆分的人名、数学进制题、Yangian 标题术语、引文键及新闻民调词语。爱沙尼亚语议会文本无法确定共同触发模式。

patterns.name: 换行与章节/条目结构标记
patterns.trigger: «↵»、«---»、«=» 后接数字，以及 «Introduction»；也包括 bibliography、author、title 等标签
patterns.context: 学术文本中，尤其是 ArXiv 论文的参考文献、元数据和章节边界附近；激活集中在换行、分隔线及其后的格式字符，不一定要求具体主题
patterns.domain: ArXiv 学术论文及其结构化文本

patterns.name: 专名中的分词片段
patterns.context: 人名被拆成多个 token，可能含罕见拼写或变音符号；激活落在专名的内部 token 上
patterns.domain: 论文作者、引文姓名及新闻文本中的人名

patterns.name: 数字与进制算术格式
patterns.trigger: 二进制串和 «+»、«?»，以及 «In base 14»、«In base 11» 等表达
patterns.context: 题目以不同进制表示数字并要求计算；长数字串中的部分 token 与运算符被标记

patterns.name: 论文标题中的技术术语片段
patterns.context: 学术标题提及 Yangian 双对应及自由玻色子表示；激活尤其出现在 Yangian 术语的拆分片段
patterns.domain: 数学物理 / 理论物理

patterns.name: 民调表述中的 poll
patterns.context: 新闻文章谈及民众对同性婚姻的态度及民调来源
patterns.domain: 新闻 / 政治与社会议题

patterns.name: 参考文献与编号格式
patterns.context: 正文引用文献时出现作者名、引用键和年份等格式；与专名片段同时出现

en.concept: Marked proper nouns and structured text fragments
en.description: Primarily responds to tokenized Polish place names and Wikipedia village-entry templates; other sporadic triggers come from shell paths, build scripts, paper formatting/metadata, and XML GUIDs, with no unified semantic condition.

patterns.name: Tokenization and article templates for Polish place names
patterns.context: Titles or opening sentences of geographic entries; mostly Polish place names, administrative names, and county names, often marked as subword fragments

patterns.name: Command-line paths and configuration file fragments
patterns.context: Unix shell commands, configuration paths, and script calls; activation centers on character fragments in paths or filenames and command connectors

patterns.name: libiberty path in FreeBSD build scripts
patterns.context: pre-configure build rules for FreeBSD ports, especially entering the libiberty directory to run configuration or build commands

patterns.name: Mathematical physics titles and formatting markers
patterns.context: Text mixing paper titles, mathematical formulas, and LaTeX/formatting artifacts

patterns.name: Paper authors and title/abstract boundaries
patterns.context: Separation structure between paper metadata, title, and abstract; text contains an author line and a repeated title

patterns.name: GUID strings in XML attributes
patterns.context: In an XML Model element, the Id attribute contains a GUID grouped by hyphens; activation falls within the identifier

9_2929.concept: 带标记的专名与结构化文本片段
9_2929.description: 主要响应被拆分标记的波兰地名及维基村落条目模板；其余零散触发分别来自 shell 路径、构建脚本、论文排版/元数据和 XML GUID，未见统一语义条件。

patterns.name: 波兰地名的分词与条目模板
patterns.trigger: 地名内部被拆分标记的片段，如 «Lub(in)»、«Voivodeship»、«Lip(n)ica»；并在条目正文出现 «is a village in the administrative district of Gmina»
patterns.context: 地名条目的标题或首句；多为波兰语地名、行政区名及县名，常按子词片段标记
patterns.domain: 英文维基百科地理条目

patterns.name: 命令行路径及配置文件片段
patterns.context: Unix shell 命令、配置路径和脚本调用，激活集中在路径或文件名的字符片段及命令连接符

patterns.name: FreeBSD 构建脚本中的 libiberty 路径
patterns.context: FreeBSD ports 的 pre-configure 构建规则，尤其是进入 libiberty 目录执行配置或构建

patterns.name: 数学物理标题与排版标记
patterns.trigger: «$»、«q»-«affine»-«Yangian»、«double correspondence»、«free boson representation»，另有 «=»、«15»、«pt» 和章节标题标记
patterns.context: 论文标题、数学公式及 LaTeX/排版残留混杂的文本

patterns.name: 论文作者与题名/摘要边界
patterns.trigger: «omi»、«Re»、«u» 等作者名片段，以及 «title»、«:»、«Experimental realization»、«Stochastic resetting»
patterns.context: 论文元数据与题名、摘要之间的分隔结构；文本含作者行和标题重复

patterns.name: XML 属性中的 GUID 字符串
patterns.context: XML 的 Model 元素中，Id 属性包含以连字符分组的 GUID；激活落在标识符内部

en.concept: Separators and proper-name fragments in structured text
en.description: Primarily responds to administrative templates and split Polish proper names in Polish village entries; also shows strong activation on paper metadata/typographic separators, equation fragments, build-script paths, and CSS hierarchical selectors.

patterns.name: Polish village administrative template
patterns.context: Village entries describing the gmina, county, and other administrative divisions; Polish place names' internal token fragments are also highlighted.

patterns.name: Fragmented spellings of Polish place names
patterns.context: Polish proper names embedded in English articles; activation is distributed across names, administrative-unit names, and their component fragments.
patterns.domain: Polish place names and administrative-unit proper names

patterns.name: Document separators and title metadata
patterns.context: Line breaks, horizontal rules, or equals-sign separators appear near document or paper titles, metadata, and section markers.
patterns.domain: ArXiv paper excerpts and document formatting

patterns.name: ArXiv paper titles and author fields
patterns.context: Title fields and line breaks in author lists within paper metadata; title topics vary, with no unified disciplinary content.

patterns.name: Mathematical formulas or typesetting fragments
patterns.context: Numbers and symbols are adjacent in formulas, LaTeX, or converted paper-layout fragments; segment 1 also includes a section heading.

patterns.name: Paths and command separators in build scripts
patterns.context: Near paths, command chaining operators, and line breaks in FreeBSD ports shell configuration scripts.
patterns.domain: GitHub source code and build scripts

patterns.name: CSS selector hierarchy
patterns.context: Consecutive descendant combinators and tag names in CSS rules and DOM hierarchy selectors.

9_2929.concept: 结构化文本中的分隔符与专名片段
9_2929.description: 主要响应波兰村庄条目中的行政区模板与被切分的波兰专名；另对论文元数据/排版分隔、公式残片、构建脚本路径和 CSS 层级选择器出现较强激活。

patterns.name: 波兰村庄行政区模板
patterns.trigger: « the»6« administrative»2« district»2 of G«mina»9 ... «,»8« within»9
patterns.context: 村庄条目中介绍所属 gmina、县等行政区；同时高亮波兰地名内部的分词片段。
patterns.domain: 英文维基百科地理条目

patterns.name: 波兰地名的片段化拼写
patterns.trigger: «ś»、«ę»，以及 «Sz»«am»«ot»«u»«ły»、«G»«mina» 等被拆分的地名片段
patterns.context: 波兰语专名嵌在英文条目中；激活分布于名字、行政区名称及其组成片段。
patterns.domain: 波兰地名与行政区专名

patterns.name: 文档分隔符与标题元数据
patterns.context: 文档或论文的标题、元数据、章节标记附近出现换行、横线或等号分隔。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文片段及文档格式

patterns.name: ArXiv 论文标题与作者字段
patterns.context: 论文元数据中标题字段及作者名单换行；标题主题各异，未见统一学科内容。

patterns.name: 数学公式或排版残片
patterns.context: 公式、LaTeX 或转换后的论文排版残片中，数字与符号紧邻；段1还含章节标题。

patterns.name: 编译脚本中的路径与命令分隔
patterns.context: FreeBSD ports 的 shell 配置脚本中，路径、命令连接符和换行附近。

patterns.name: CSS 选择器层级
patterns.context: CSS 规则及 DOM 层级选择器中，连续的子代组合符号和标签名。

en.concept: Proper names and formatting fragments across domains
en.description: Activation spans many unrelated text types: the most prominent group is templates and place-name fragments in Polish village entries; others include math numbering, nuclear physics terminology, mathematical bibliographies, Hardy-space prose, and football names. No single trigger pattern explains all segments.

patterns.name: Polish village entry template
patterns.context: In Wikipedia entries for Polish villages and administrative units, titles or body text contain consecutive split Polish place names and administrative names; especially pronounced for names following Gmina.

patterns.name: Subword fragment activation in place names
patterns.context: Trigger fragments occur within proper names as subword/byte fragments; segments 2, 3, 5, 8, and 9 also show the village-entry template, but the samples do not establish what specific fragment type triggers it.
patterns.domain: Polish proper names and place names

patterns.name: Latin-letter numeric mathematical formatting
patterns.context: Near AMS classification codes and similar typesetting markers in mathematical papers.

patterns.name: Fragments in baryon-physics formulas
patterns.context: In physics terminology about nuclear reactions, Coulomb interactions, and Faddeev equations, especially near split proper names/abbreviations.

patterns.name: Bibliography on probability and integration
patterns.context: Bibliographic titles in papers; multiple tokenized fragments of mathematical terms are hit.

patterns.name: Hardy-space descriptions
patterns.context: Mathematical paper prose discussing Gaussian estimates, the relationship between \(H^p\) and \(L^p\), and Riesz transforms.

patterns.name: Names in football history text
patterns.context: Names are split into multiple tokens in accounts of European Cup finals and Polish football players.

9_2929.concept: 多领域专名与格式碎片
9_2929.description: 激活跨多种互不相同文本：最突出的一组是波兰乡村条目的模板和地名碎片；另有数学编号、核物理术语、数学书目、Hardy空间正文及足球人名。未见能解释全部段落的单一触发模式。

patterns.name: 波兰乡村条目模板
patterns.trigger: “village”, “in the administrative district of Gmina”, “within … County”及地名内部的分词片段
patterns.context: 波兰村名及行政区名称的 Wikipedia 条目中，标题或正文连续出现被拆分的波兰地名、行政区划名；对 Gmina 后的名称尤其明显。

patterns.name: 地名中的词片段激活
patterns.trigger: 地名被拆分的片段，如 «R»«ok»«it»«no»、«Tr»«z»«eb»«iat»«ów»、«B»«ia»«ła»，以及 «G»«mina» 后的名称
patterns.context: 出现在专名的子词/字节片段中；段2、3、5、8、9与乡村条目模板同时出现，具体是哪类片段触发无法从样例确定。

patterns.name: 拉丁字母数字数学格式
patterns.trigger: «15»、«=»、«0»、«.»、«30»等数学分类编号或公式样式 token
patterns.context: 数学论文的 AMS 分类编号及类似排版标记附近。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学论文元数据/排版

patterns.name: 重子物理公式中的碎片
patterns.context: 核反应、Coulomb 相互作用和 Faddeev 方程的物理学术语中，尤其是被拆分的专名/缩写附近。

patterns.name: 概率与积分主题书目
patterns.context: 论文 bibliography 中的书目标题，命中多个数学术语的分词片段。

patterns.name: Hardy 空间表述
patterns.trigger: « this»、« we»、« that»、« the»、« R»«ies»«z»、« our»、«Hardy» «space»
patterns.context: 讨论 Gaussian estimates、\(H^p\) 与 \(L^p\) 关系及 Riesz 变换的数学论文正文。

patterns.name: 足球史文本中的人名
patterns.context: 欧洲冠军杯决赛及波兰足球运动员的叙述中，人名被拆成多个 token。

en.concept: Polish name fragments and heterogeneous formatting features
en.description: The strongest and most repeated pattern is tokenized fragments in Polish names, especially the Z/b/ign/iew fragments of Zbigniew. Other activation is scattered across numeric identifiers, code, paths, formulas, and formatting, without a unified semantic cue.

patterns.name: Token fragments in Polish personal names
patterns.context: Activation is most concentrated on Polish names, especially Zbigniew, which begins with Z and is tokenized into b/ign/iew fragments; letter fragments in other Polish names also appear. Names may occur in body text or at marked tokenization boundaries.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic text about Polish figures, sports, and music, as well as European Parliament text

patterns.name: Sequences of fragments in personal or proper names
patterns.context: These fragments occur in the name of Polish parliamentarian Andrzej Grzyb; similar to the pattern of full Polish names in other examples, but not confirmed as the same specific name pattern.

patterns.name: Numeric identifiers and code characters
patterns.context: Activation falls on number strings in HackerNews URLs and indentation tabs in Github build scripts; there is no clear Polish-name context.

patterns.name: Formula, punctuation, and formatting fragments
patterns.context: Triggers are scattered across formulas, units, separator lines, and title formatting in mathematical papers, with no clear condition connecting them to the name pattern.

patterns.name: Long path or hash identifier fragments
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on hexadecimal-style identifier fragments after a lambda-related path in a Github URL.

patterns.name: Configuration paths and command text
patterns.context: Activation occurs around configuration file paths, command lines, and script filenames, including repeated path fragments; it may relate to paths or code formatting, but the examples are insufficient to determine this.

9_2929.concept: 波兰姓名片段与异质格式特征
9_2929.description: 最强且重复的模式是波兰姓名中的分词片段，尤以 Zbigniew 的 Z/b/ign/iew 片段突出。其余激活分散于数字标识符、代码、路径、公式和排版，缺少统一语义线索。

patterns.name: 波兰人名的分词片段
patterns.trigger: «Z»、«b»、«ign»、«iew»；以及人名内部的 «dz»、«is»、«ł»、«aw» 等片段
patterns.context: 触发最集中于波兰姓名，尤其以 Z 开头、分词后包含 b/ign/iew 的 Zbigniew；也出现其他波兰姓名中的字母片段。姓名可出现在正文或被标记的分词边界处。
patterns.domain: 关于波兰人物、体育、音乐的百科文本，以及欧洲议会文本

patterns.name: 人名或专名中的连续片段
patterns.context: 这些片段出现在波兰议会代表 Andrzej Grzyb 的姓名中；与其他样例中完整波兰姓名的模式相似，但不能确认是同一特定姓名模式。

patterns.name: 数字标识符与代码字符
patterns.context: 激活落在 HackerNews URL 的数字串和 Github 构建脚本的缩进制表符上；没有明确的波兰姓名上下文。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 链接、Github 构建脚本

patterns.name: 公式、标点与排版片段
patterns.context: 触发分散在数学论文的公式、单位、分隔线和标题排版中，未见与人名模式相连的明显条件。

patterns.name: 长路径或哈希标识符片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在 Github URL 中 lambda 相关路径后的十六进制样式标识符片段。

patterns.name: 配置路径及命令文本
patterns.context: 激活出现在配置文件路径、命令行和脚本文件名周围，包括重复路径片段；可能与路径或代码格式有关，但样例不足以确定。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答／shell 命令

en.concept: Rare proper names and unusual forms at tokenization boundaries
en.description: Activation often occurs on split proper names or unusual forms: Polish and other Slavic names, place names, and Cyrillic forms, as well as French century ordinals, hash identifiers, and Thai place names.

patterns.name: Letter sequences in Polish names
patterns.context: In Polish names, especially the tokenized letter sequence of Zbigniew; activation spans different positions in the name and adjacent name components.
patterns.domain: Biographical entries, sports reports, parliamentary text

patterns.name: Slavic script and word-form fragments
patterns.context: Cyrillic words split into multiple tokens, involving adjectives or place-name/ethnonym-like forms; no clear context matching the Polish-name pattern.
patterns.domain: Word lists or code data on Github

patterns.name: Polish place-name morphemes
patterns.context: In Polish administrative divisions and place-name text, segmented morphemes within place names are activated.

patterns.name: Eastern European names and proper nouns
patterns.context: Slavic surnames embedded in names of mathematical methods show segmented activation.

patterns.name: French century ordinal forms
patterns.context: In French text, spelled-out century ordinals are split, surrounded by historical book titles and biographical narrative.

patterns.name: Hash or identifier fragments
patterns.context: Mixed numeric and alphabetic identifiers at the ends of Github paths or links are activated.

patterns.name: Thai place names and team names
patterns.context: Proper names such as place names and team names in Thai event data show segmented activation.

patterns.name: Letter fragments in mathematicians' names
patterns.context: Multiple-part surnames are split in mathematical paper references or names; activation falls on internal name fragments.

9_2929.concept: 分词边界中的稀有专名与特殊词形
9_2929.description: 激活多见于拆分的专名或特殊词形：波兰及其他斯拉夫姓名、地名和西里尔词形，也包括法语世纪序数、哈希标识符及泰国地名。

patterns.name: 波兰语姓名中的字母序列
patterns.trigger: 「Z»b»ign»iew」及更长姓名片段，如「Z»b»ign»iew» Bon»iek」「Z»b»ign»iew» Wi»ęckowski」「Z»dz»is»ł»aw» Z»b»igniew» Pod»ka»ński」
patterns.context: 波兰姓名中，尤其是 Zbigniew 的分词字母序列；激活分布在名字不同位置及相邻姓名成分上。
patterns.domain: 人物条目、体育报道、议会文本

patterns.name: 斯拉夫语文字与词形片段
patterns.context: 西里尔字母词语被拆成多个 token，涉及形容词或地名/民族称谓式词形；没有明显与波兰姓名模式相同的语境。
patterns.domain: Github 中的词表或代码数据

patterns.name: 波兰地名词素
patterns.context: 波兰行政区划和地名文本中，地名内部的分段词素被激活。

patterns.name: 东欧人名及专名
patterns.context: 数学方法名称中包含的斯拉夫语姓氏出现分段激活。

patterns.name: 法语世纪序数写法
patterns.context: 法语文本中，拼写出来的世纪序数词被拆分，周围是历史书名及传记叙述。

patterns.name: 哈希或标识符片段
patterns.context: Github 路径或链接末尾的混合数字、字母标识符被激活。

patterns.name: 泰国地名与球队名称
patterns.context: 泰国赛事资料中的地名、球队名等专名出现分段激活。

patterns.name: 数学家姓名中的字母片段
patterns.context: 数学论文参考文献或人名中，多段姓氏被拆分；激活落在姓名内部片段。

en.concept: In-word fragments and proper-name/technical text
en.description: Activation is scattered across in-word fragments of proper names (especially place and personal names), academic terminology, typographic symbols, and Cyrillic word lists; a few common English function words also activate. Cross-domain consistency is weak, with no single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Internal fragments of place names, ethnonyms, and proper names
patterns.context: Trigger fragments occur within proper names, especially place names, administrative units, ethnonyms, or personal names; fragments may cross word boundaries and need not correspond to complete words.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia geography articles and names in academic literature

patterns.name: Fragments of academic terminology and technical vocabulary
patterns.context: Occurs in mathematical, physical, or theoretical-research terminology and titles; triggers fall both on complete terms and on internal term fragments.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics and theoretical physics text

patterns.name: Spelling and in-word segmentation of personal names
patterns.context: Activation falls on different subword fragments of personal names, commonly in paper citations, author lists, or academic prose.

patterns.name: Cyrillic word-list entries
patterns.context: In newline-separated entries or word lists, activation falls within Cyrillic words; these lines include Latin-letter abbreviations.

patterns.name: Mathematical expressions and typographic markers
patterns.context: Triggers occur in formulas, line breaks, separators, and typographic sizing, and may be unrelated to adjacent text content.

patterns.name: Common function words and frequent fragments
patterns.context: These common English words sporadically activate across domains and syntactic positions, without stable semantic or syntactic conditions.

9_2929.concept: 词内片段与专名/技术文本
9_2929.description: 激活分散于专名（尤其地名、人名）的词内片段、学术术语、排版符号和西里尔词表；少量常见英文功能词也激活。跨领域一致性弱，无法归结为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 地名、族名及专名内部片段
patterns.context: 触发片段出现在专名内部，尤其是地名、行政区、族名或人名；片段可能跨词边界，未必对应完整词。
patterns.domain: 百科地理条目及学术文献中的人名

patterns.name: 学术术语及技术词汇片段
patterns.context: 出现在数学、物理学或理论研究的术语和标题中；触发既落在完整术语词上，也落在术语内部片段。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学与理论物理文本

patterns.name: 人名的拼写与词内切分
patterns.context: 激活落在人名的不同子词片段上，常见于论文引用、作者列表或学术叙述。

patterns.name: 西里尔字母词表条目
patterns.context: 在换行分隔的条目或词表中，激活落于西里尔字母词语内部；这些行附有拉丁字母缩写。
patterns.domain: GitHub 上的西里尔文字列表

patterns.name: 数学表达式与排版标记
patterns.context: 触发出现在公式、换行、分隔线及排版尺寸等结构中，与相邻文字内容未必相关。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 文档的 LaTeX/Markdown 排版

patterns.name: 普通功能词及常见片段
patterns.context: 这些常见英文词在不同领域、句法位置中零星激活，未显示稳定的特定语义或句法条件。

en.concept: Rounding instructions and technical text fragments
en.description: Primarily responds to “Round/rounded ... to the nearest” in math problems and specified rounding precision; also shows sporadic activation on German place names and bus routes, the Shapiro-Wilk normality test, and CSF command-line paths and Ubuntu shell prompts.

patterns.name: Rounding to a specified precision
patterns.context: Math problems ask to round a calculated result or given value to a specified digit; strong activation concentrates on “nearest” and the following precision expression

patterns.name: Specific English place names and route names
patterns.context: Geographical descriptions of bus routes, stops, and rail replacement services; multiple place names are split into subwords

patterns.name: Statistical normality test
patterns.context: Describes statistical testing of a time variable; activation concentrates around “using” and the test name

patterns.name: CSF tool commands and script paths
patterns.context: Shows CSF configuration directories, test scripts, or uninstall commands on Linux

patterns.name: Terminal prompts and grep commands
