patterns.context: Shell prompts, search commands, and following chat content quoted in Ubuntu IRC discussions

9_2929.concept: 舍入指令与技术文本片段
9_2929.description: 主要响应数学题中“Round/rounded ... to the nearest”及具体舍入精度；另对德国地名与公交线路、Shapiro-Wilk 正态性检验，以及 CSF 命令行路径和 Ubuntu shell 提示符有零星激活。

patterns.name: 四舍五入到指定精度
patterns.trigger: “Round ... to the nearest”后接“one hundred”“one hundred thousand”“1000000”“10000”或“one thousand”；另见“rounded to three decimal places”
patterns.context: 数学题中要求将计算结果或给定数值舍入到指定数位；强激活集中在“nearest”以及后续数位表达
patterns.domain: 数学练习、数值舍入问答

patterns.name: 特定英文地名与线路名
patterns.context: 公交线路、车站及铁路替代服务的地理介绍；多个地名被拆分为子词

patterns.name: 统计正态性检验
patterns.trigger: “tested for normality using the Shapiro-Wilk test”
patterns.context: 描述对时间变量进行统计检验；激活集中于“using”及检验名称附近

patterns.name: CSF 工具命令与脚本路径
patterns.context: 展示 Linux 上 CSF 配置目录、测试脚本或卸载命令

patterns.name: 终端提示符与 grep 命令
patterns.context: Ubuntu IRC 对话中引用 shell 提示符、搜索命令和后续聊天内容

en.concept: Mixed: rounding problem format and bus route descriptions
en.description: Items 1–9 activate on rounding instructions, precision units, numbers and operators, and line-break answers in algebra problems; item 10 activates on encyclopedia descriptions of bus routes, connections, and places served, differing from the math pattern.

patterns.name: Precision terms in rounding instructions
patterns.context: After solving for a variable, math problems require rounding to a specified number of digits or order of magnitude; triggers cover the instruction and nearby precision terms, such as “nearest 1000000”, “nearest one hundred thousand”, “nearest 10000”, “nearest ten thousand”.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics, arithmetic and algebra word problems

patterns.name: Numbers and operators
patterns.context: Numbers, minus signs, equal signs, and calculations densely occur in math problems, especially near rounding requirements and answers; some numbers are split by tokenization.

patterns.name: Answer lines and line-break boundaries
patterns.context: A numerical answer appears on the next line after a rounding instruction; activation often covers the line break and several subwords of the answer number.

patterns.name: Bus routes and transport connections
patterns.context: Encyclopedic descriptions of local bus lines, replacement rail services, and connected places along the route.

9_2929.concept: 混合：取整题格式与公交路线叙述
9_2929.description: 1–9集中于代数题的取整指令、精度单位、数字运算符及换行答案；10则激活于公交路线、连接与途经地点的百科表述，和数学模式不同。

patterns.name: 取整指令中的精度词
patterns.trigger: “Round … to the nearest”，尤其是 “nearest” 后的数量级表达
patterns.context: 数学题在求出变量后要求按指定位数或数量级取整；触发覆盖指令及相邻精度词，如 “nearest 1000000”、“nearest one hundred thousand”、“nearest 10000”、“nearest ten thousand”。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics，算术与代数文字题

patterns.name: 数字和运算符号
patterns.context: 数学题中密集出现数字、负号、等号和计算式，尤其靠近取整要求与答案；部分数字被分词切开。

patterns.name: 答案行及换行边界
patterns.context: 题目要求取整后，下一行给出数字答案；激活常覆盖换行符以及答案数字的若干子词。

patterns.name: 公交路线与交通连接表述
patterns.context: 介绍某地公交线路、替代铁路服务及沿途连接地点的百科叙述。

en.concept: Local fixed phrases and formatting fragments
en.description: Activation appears in various local fixed fragments: rounding instructions, statistical-analysis headings and test phrasing, transport routes and place names, build-script operators, and biographical legal expressions, medical terminology, and proper names in mathematical inequalities. These patterns cross domains, with no unified semantic or grammatical trigger condition.

patterns.name: “to the nearest” instruction in numeric rounding problems
patterns.context: Occurs in math problems asking to round a calculated result to a specified digit; activation concentrates on “nearest” and adjacent formatting instructions, followed by the rounded result.

patterns.name: Statistical-analysis subsection headings
patterns.context: An independent statistical-analysis subsection heading in a paper, often with Markdown/LaTeX-style separator lines, followed by statistical methods, software, or tests.

patterns.name: Test and statistical-method phrasing
patterns.context: Describes variable normality testing or statistical tests between groups; activation falls on local fragments of test terms, method connectives, and test names.

patterns.name: Public-transport routes and station names
patterns.context: In descriptions of local German transport routes connecting places; place names are split into multiple subwords, and activation concentrates on route terms and some place-name fragments.

patterns.name: Shell operators in configuration scripts
patterns.context: Build configuration scripts use shell && to chain commands and backslashes for line continuation; activation mainly falls on command-chain and continuation symbols.

patterns.name: Formal occupational title phrase in biographies
patterns.context: Biographical accounts of a person qualifying to practice law use the fixed expression “called to the Bar” in the English and Irish legal context.

patterns.name: Endocrine anatomy terminology
patterns.context: Historical medical accounts of glands and endocrine research involve “internal secretion” and the adrenal gland; activation falls on terminology fragments.

patterns.name: Proper-name fragments in mathematical inequality names
patterns.context: Mathematics papers mention the Beckner inequality and related literature; activation concentrates on subwords of split proper names and inequality.

9_2929.concept: 局部固定短语与格式片段
9_2929.description: 激活出现在多种局部固定片段：舍入指令、统计分析标题与检验措辞、交通线路及地名、构建脚本连接符，以及传记法律表达、医学术语和数学不等式专名；这些模式跨领域，未见统一语义或语法触发条件。

patterns.name: 数字舍入题中的“to the nearest”指令
patterns.trigger: “Round« r»1« to»4« the»3« nearest»10« one»6« thousand»6”以及“Round i« to»4« the»2« nearest»9« 10000”
patterns.context: 出现在要求把计算结果舍入到指定数位的数学题中，激活集中在“nearest”及其相邻格式化指令；题目随后给出舍入结果。

patterns.name: 统计分析小节标题
patterns.context: 作为论文中独立的统计分析小节标题，常带有 Markdown/LaTeX 式分隔线，后接统计方法、软件或检验。

patterns.name: 检验与统计方法措辞
patterns.trigger: “«tested»4 for norm«ality»1”“«using»9« the»10« Shapiro»4-Wil«k»4« test»2”及“«using»9« unpaired»6 *»3«t»5*-»2«test»4”
patterns.context: 描述变量正态性检验或组间统计检验；激活落在测试、方法连接词及检验名称的局部片段。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文的方法与结果

patterns.name: 公共交通线路与站名
patterns.context: 德国地方交通线路说明中，线路连接地点；地名被拆分为多个子词，激活集中于线路、路线及部分地名片段。
patterns.domain: 百科全书地理/交通条目

patterns.name: 配置脚本中的 shell 连接符
patterns.context: 构建配置脚本中用 shell 的 && 连接命令，并以反斜杠续行；激活主要落在命令连接与续行符号。

patterns.name: 传记中的正式职业称谓前缀
patterns.context: 传记叙述人物取得律师执业资格时，使用英爱法律语境中的固定表达“called to the Bar”。

patterns.name: 内分泌解剖术语
patterns.context: 历史医学叙述腺体及内分泌研究时，涉及“internal secretion”和肾上腺；激活落在术语片段。

patterns.name: 数学不等式名称中的专名片段
patterns.context: 数学论文提及 Beckner 不等式及相关文献；激活集中于专名被拆分后的子词及 inequality。

en.concept: Formatted proper names and rounding instructions in text
en.description: Primarily responds to rounding instructions such as “Round…to the nearest…” in math problems and answer/problem boundaries; also shows weaker, scattered responses to split foreign proper names, sections, timelines, classifications, and transport language in encyclopedias, as well as statistical-test terminology in papers.

patterns.name: Rounding instructions in math problems
patterns.context: After an algebraic or numeric expression, asks to calculate a variable and round to a specified precision or number of places; often accompanied by an answer line and the next problem's “Let”.

patterns.name: Math answer lines and problem boundaries
patterns.context: Immediately follows a math problem's answer, or the next subproblem begins after the answer; related to the format of rounding problems.

patterns.name: Accent characters and syllable splits in place names
patterns.context: Characters in place names, personal names, or institution names are split into multiple tokens; includes accented characters or non-English spellings.

patterns.name: Foreign spellings and syllable fragments in proper names
patterns.context: European personal names, taxonomic authorities, or historical figures in encyclopedia prose; names are tokenized into multiple substrings.

patterns.name: Statistical test terminology
patterns.context: Describes a method for testing variable normality, appearing in statistical-analysis sentences in medical research.

patterns.name: Transport routes and rail replacement
patterns.context: Introduces a bus route connecting places and states that it replaces rail service.

patterns.name: Encyclopedia navigation and references headings
patterns.context: Section headings, related-article links, and reference navigation at the end of local articles.

patterns.name: Dates and biographical timelines
patterns.context: Historical figures' birth or death entries arranged by date, with a name and brief identification following the date.

patterns.name: Taxonomic classification and description sources
patterns.context: Describes biological classification and species, including their naming or first describer.

9_2929.concept: 文本中的格式化专名与取整指令
9_2929.description: 主要响应数学题中“Round…to the nearest…”等取整指令及答案/题目边界；另对百科中的拆分外语专名、栏目、年表、分类与交通表述，以及论文统计检验术语有较弱且分散的响应。

patterns.name: 数学题中的取整指令
patterns.trigger: “Round ... to the nearest ...”, “rounded to ... dp”, “decimal places”
patterns.context: 代数或数值表达式之后，要求计算变量并按指定精度或位数取整；常伴随答案行及下一题的“Let”。

patterns.name: 数学题答案行与题目边界
patterns.context: 紧跟数学题的答案，或答案后开始下一小题；与取整题格式相关。

patterns.name: 地名中的重音字母及音节拆分
patterns.context: 地名、人名或机构名称中，字符被拆成多个 token；包含重音字符或非英语拼写。

patterns.name: 专名中的外语拼写与音节片段
patterns.context: 百科叙述中的欧洲人名、物种命名者或历史人物姓名，姓名被分词为多个子串。

patterns.name: 统计检验术语
patterns.context: 描述变量正态性检验的方法，出现在医学研究的统计分析句中。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学论文

patterns.name: 交通线路与铁路替代
patterns.trigger: “Bus route”“Bus line”“runs as a replacement for”
patterns.context: 介绍公交线路连接地点，并说明其替代铁路服务。

patterns.name: 百科条目导航与参考文献标题
patterns.context: 地方条目末尾的栏目标题、相关条目链接及参考文献导航。

patterns.name: 日期与人物年表
patterns.context: 按日期排列的历史人物出生或逝世条目，日期后接姓名和简短身份介绍。

patterns.name: 物种分类与描述来源
patterns.trigger: “family Erebidae”“Its only species”“described by”“first described by”
patterns.context: 说明生物分类、物种及其命名或首次描述者。

en.concept: Specific word forms and token fragments
en.description: Activation is distributed across various specific word forms and token fragments: the “using the” structure in statistical papers, German place-name/address fragments, Polish word forms and names, Russian transliteration word lists, and numbers and rounding expressions in math problems; no clear unified semantics.

patterns.name: “using the” / “for using the” structure in English sentences
patterns.context: In academic descriptions of statistical methods or variable normality tests, activation concentrates on “using the” following a preposition; [1] also has the neighboring context “« tested» … «ality»”.

patterns.name: German place-name components
patterns.context: German spelling fragments in place names or addresses, especially segments beginning with Sch; [2] also includes Weil-/Schm- place-name components.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia geography, institutional addresses, and biographies

patterns.name: Polish personal names and word-form fragments
patterns.context: Diacritic word forms and personal names in Polish text; activation is scattered across multiple subword fragments within names.
patterns.domain: Polish parliamentary text and encyclopedia literary history

patterns.name: Russian word-form transliteration/cross-reference entries
patterns.context: Word-list-style entries pairing Cyrillic forms with Latin-letter transliterations in parentheses; activation is especially pronounced in Cyrillic sequences.
patterns.domain: Language or transliteration data in code repositories

patterns.name: Specific numbers and formatting in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: In math problems' calculations, negative numbers, and rounding questions, number fragments and nearest/million-scale phrasing activate; the pattern may be affected by number tokenization.

9_2929.concept: 特定词形与分词片段
9_2929.description: 激活分布于多种特定词形和分词片段：统计论文的 using the 结构、德语地名/地址片段、波兰语词形与人名、俄语转写词表，以及数学题中的数字和取整表达；没有明显统一语义。

patterns.name: 英文句子中的 using the / for using the 结构
patterns.context: 统计方法或变量正态性检验的学术描述中，激活集中于介词后接 using the；[1] 另有“« tested» … «ality»”的邻近上下文。

patterns.name: 德语地名构成片段
patterns.context: 地名或地址中的德语拼写片段，尤其是 Sch 起始的词段；[2] 还有 Weil-/Schm- 地名成分。
patterns.domain: 百科地理、机构地址及人物传记

patterns.name: 波兰语人名及词形片段
patterns.context: 波兰语文本中的变音符号词形及人名，激活分散在姓名内部的多个子词片段。
patterns.domain: 波兰语议会文本与百科文学史

patterns.name: 俄语词形的转写/对照条目
patterns.context: 俄文字形与括号内拉丁字母转写并列的词表式条目；激活在西里尔字母序列中尤明显。
patterns.domain: 代码仓库中的语言或转写数据

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的特定数字与格式
patterns.context: 数学题的算式、负数和取整提问中，数字片段及 nearest/百万级表述处有激活；模式可能受数字分词影响。

en.concept: Structured terminology and phrasing across multiple domains
en.description: Activation covers statistical tests and analysis methods, segmented French proper nouns or place names, math rounding problems, existence-and-uniqueness phrasing in mathematical papers, and adrenal-related terms; the patterns are locally identifiable in tokens or phrasing, but do not share a domain.

patterns.name: Statistical tests and normality analysis
patterns.context: In statistical-method phrasing, verbs such as test and analyze are followed by by/using and the name of a statistical test or method; also includes testing phrasing around normality and distribution.

patterns.name: French proper nouns and place-name fragments
patterns.context: Place names or proper nouns in French text are split into multiple subword tokens; triggers are distributed within the names and do not involve the same fixed place name.
patterns.domain: French parliamentary text and English Wikipedia place-name entries

patterns.name: Numerical rounding in mathematical text
patterns.context: In rounding problems, nearest is followed by a place-value unit or number, often near numbers, round/rounded, and the answer.

patterns.name: Purpose and existence-and-uniqueness phrasing in mathematical papers
patterns.context: Research goals are stated in paper introductions or summaries of results, including the phrase existence and uniqueness.

patterns.name: Anatomical term fragments
patterns.context: When discussing endocrine glands, adrenal glands, and researchers, triggers fall within proper nouns or anatomical terms.
patterns.domain: Medical history or physiology Wikipedia articles

9_2929.concept: 多领域中的结构化术语与句式
9_2929.description: 激活覆盖统计检验与分析方法、拆分的法语专名或地名、数学取整题，以及数学论文的存在唯一性表述和肾上腺相关术语；各模式在局部 token/句式上可辨，但领域并不统一。

patterns.name: 统计检验与正态性分析
patterns.trigger: « tested»、«using»、«the» Shapiro-Wilk test；«by» coefficient of product-moment correlation；«by» the Kolmogorov-Smirnov test
patterns.context: 统计分析方法句式中，检验、分析等动词之后接 by/using 和统计检验或方法名称；也包括 normality 与 distribution 周边的检验表述。
patterns.domain: 医学论文的方法与结果

patterns.name: 法语专名与地名片段
patterns.context: 法语文本中的地名或专名被拆成多个子词 token；触发分布在名称内部，并非同一个固定地名。
patterns.domain: 法语议会文本及英语维基百科地名条目

patterns.name: 数学文本中的数值取整
patterns.context: 取整题目中 nearest 后跟数位单位或数值，附近常出现数字、round/rounded 和答案。

patterns.name: 数学论文的目的与存在唯一性表述
patterns.trigger: «The» aim … of «this» paper is to «establish» «existence» and «uniqueness»
patterns.context: 论文引言或结果概述中陈述研究目标，并列举 existence and uniqueness。

patterns.name: 解剖学术语片段

en.concept: Proper names and formatted text fragments
en.description: Activation is scattered across subword fragments of multilingual place names, personal names, and words, as well as statistical tests, numeric formatting, transport, sports, and legal text; these contexts lack consistent semantic trigger conditions.

patterns.name: Internal subword fragments of proper names
patterns.context: Activation occurs on certain tokenized fragments of proper names, place names, or common words; adjacent subwords within the same word differ in strength, with no unified semantic condition

patterns.name: Address and place-name fields
patterns.context: Place names and administrative fields appear in addresses, institutional affiliations, or descriptions of locations

patterns.name: Statistical test names
patterns.context: Describes research data analysis, group comparisons, normality tests, or correlation analysis

patterns.name: Numbers and numeric formats
patterns.context: Numbers, numerical rounding, or case numbers, dates, and case citations in legal references

patterns.name: Finnish inflected word fragments
patterns.context: Inflected Finnish word forms in sentences discussing problems and harms affecting countries or populations

patterns.name: Lists of personal names
patterns.context: Describes works published by a publishing house and lists Polish writers' names

patterns.name: Sports events and medal accounts
patterns.context: Describes an athlete's event and medal at a world championship in a specific year

patterns.name: Public-transport route descriptions
patterns.context: States that a bus route replaces rail service or connects several towns

patterns.name: U.S. state criminal-case citations
patterns.context: Defendant's arraignment date and Louisiana Court of Appeal case citations

9_2929.concept: 专名与格式化文本片段
9_2929.description: 激活散布于多语种地名、人名及词语的子词片段，也出现在统计检验、数值格式、交通、体育和法律文本中；各处缺乏一致语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 专名内部子词片段
patterns.context: 对专名、地名或普通词的某些分词片段产生激活；同一词中相邻子词片段强度不同，未见统一语义条件
patterns.domain: 多语种文本、百科、学术文本

patterns.name: 地址与地名字段
patterns.context: 地址、机构隶属信息或地点介绍中出现地名及行政区字段
patterns.domain: 论文作者地址、地理百科

patterns.name: 统计检验方法名称
patterns.context: 描述研究数据分析、组间比较、正态性检验或相关性分析

patterns.name: 数字与数值格式
patterns.context: 数字、数值舍入，或法律引文中的案件编号、日期与判例卷页

patterns.name: 芬兰语屈折词片段
patterns.context: 芬兰语句子中的屈折词形，讨论国家或人群受到的问题与损害

patterns.name: 人物姓名列表
patterns.context: 叙述某出版机构出版过的作家作品，并列举波兰作家姓名

patterns.name: 体育赛事与奖牌叙述
patterns.context: 介绍运动员在特定年份世界锦标赛的项目与奖牌

patterns.name: 公共交通线路描述
patterns.context: 说明公交线路替代铁路服务或连接多个城镇

patterns.name: 美国州刑事判例引文
patterns.context: 被告提审日期及路易斯安那州上诉法院判例引文

en.concept: Difficult to unify; leans toward statistical methods and proper-noun subwords
en.description: Activation is scattered: biomedical statistical-method phrasing (especially by and tests/software), and several within-word fragments, such as Finnish ä, proper noun Sch, and Polish place-name Tr/z; nearest also appears in a math rounding context.

patterns.name: by in statistical testing methods
patterns.context: In passive phrasing of statistical analyses or tests, by is followed by a method, test name, or software, such as “by coefficient… correlation”, “by Student's t test”, “using the Shapiro-Wilk test”, and “by using SPSS”.

patterns.name: Within-word Finnish fragments
patterns.context: Occurs inside the word “näissä” in a Finnish sentence; the context discusses problems faced by the poorest countries in rural areas.

patterns.name: Sch- spelling fragments in place names
patterns.context: Occurs within proper nouns followed by characters forming place or street names: Schmitten, Schinkelstrasse, Schladming.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic geographic text, academic institution addresses

patterns.name: thousand in numerical rounding
patterns.context: A math problem asks for variable r to be rounded to the nearest thousand; strong activation falls on nearest.

patterns.name: Consonant fragments within Polish place names
patterns.context: Located within the Polish place name Trzebiatów, which is split into multiple subword fragments.

patterns.name: tested using in statistical methods
patterns.context: Statistical variables are tested for normality, with the phrasing “were tested … using the Shapiro-Wilk test”. This matches the statistical-method context, but the word itself is not the high-activation “by” found in [1], [5], and [10].

9_2929.concept: 难以统一；偏向统计方法与专名子词
9_2929.description: 激活分散：生物医学统计方法表述（尤其by及检验/软件），以及若干词内片段，如芬兰语ä、专名Sch、波兰地名Tr/z；另见数学取整语境的nearest。

patterns.name: 统计检验方法中的 by
patterns.context: 统计分析或检验的被动表述中，by 后接方法、检验名或软件，如“by coefficient… correlation”“by Student's t test”“using the Shapiro-Wilk test”“by using SPSS”。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文方法部分

patterns.name: 芬兰语词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在芬兰语句子中，被切分在词“näissä”内部；上下文讨论农村最贫困国家遭受的问题。

patterns.name: Sch-地名拼写片段
patterns.context: 出现在专名内部，后续字符构成地名或街道名：Schmitten、Schinkelstrasse、Schladming。
patterns.domain: 百科地理文本、学术机构地址

patterns.name: 数字取整中的 thousand
patterns.context: 数学题要求将变量 r 取整到最接近的一千；强激活落在 nearest。

patterns.name: 波兰地名内部的辅音片段
patterns.context: 位于波兰地名 Trzebiatów 的内部，词被拆分为多个子词片段。

patterns.name: 统计方法中的 tested using
patterns.context: 统计变量接受正态性检验，句式为“were tested … using the Shapiro-Wilk test”。与统计方法语境相符，但该词本身并非 [1]、[5]、[10] 中的高激活“by”。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文方法部分
